title: Engineering Process Specialist - CSM
description:
**How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as project manager/specialist and technical expert for Engineering Projects and Maintenance Program task setups.
* Provide business process direction and consulting for Engineering Action Authorizations (AAs) and maintenance tasks.
* Act as liaison between Engineering and other departments to ensure timely project execution.
* Manage project activities to meet cycle time targets and escalate issues as needed.
* Ensure AA setups meet compliance standards for ADs and SCEPTRE system requirements.
* Facilitate AD coordination, Project Strategy, and Design Freeze meetings.
* Mentor engineers and maintenance staff on complex setups and SCEPTRE basics.
* Maintain professionalism, customer focus, and safety-conscious behaviors in all processes.
* Collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless information flow and process alignment.
* Practice safety-conscious behaviors in all operational processes and procedures
* Must be able to multitask in a high-volume, fast-paced working environment

**What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Bachelor of Engineering Degree (aerospace or mechanical preferred) or comparable experience in an engineering related field.
* 8-12 years of experience in program management across Airlines or OEM
* Strong commitment to safety and compliance.
* Strong analytical skills.
* Experience in project management and technical consulting for engineering processes.
* Ability to interpret technical instructions, troubleshoot, and synthesize information for AA setups.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office
* Ability to manage multiple projects under strict deadlines and shifting priorities.
* Willingness to travel and work flexible hours as needed.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Ability to produce high quality results, work in a collaborative environment by embracing diverse perspectives and with a solution-based approach.
* Adapt communication clearly and concisely based on team dynamics and expresses thoughts & ideas effectively.
* Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships.
* Ability to understand business processes, implement innovative solutions, guide juniors on continuous improvement by constantly updating oneself on current technology & trends.
* Inquisitive to understand customer and business expectations while creating value addition on technical solutions.

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* AME License holder is a preference
* Knowledge of Theory of Constraints and Critical Chain Management.
* Strong relationship management and team collaboration skills.

**About The Company**
What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service.
  
  
Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good.
  
  
In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor’s 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience.
  
  
**About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore**
The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. The organization is certified by the Great Place to Work Institute (India). The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category. This nomination highlights our remarkable volunteering initiatives and the outstanding practices we implement to encourage and support our employee volunteering program.
  
  
For more information, please visit www.deltatechhub.com
  
  
**Why join?**

* Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience.
* Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs –exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships.
* Immerse yourself in an employee-centric culture.
* Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting-edge technology driven solutions.
* Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Medical Insurance, Transportation to and from the DTH office, Complementary Cafeteria Meals, Special Travel opportunities and Travel Privileges, Car Lease Program, Paid time off, Parental Benefits and National Pension Scheme.

title: Portfolio Success manager- Accelerate
description:
**Position Name: Portfolio Success Manager – Venture Partner and Sprint Excellence**

Reports To: Head of Portfolio Success

Location: Bangalore / Chennai/ Hyderabad

**Role Overview:**

This role makes sure companies in our accelerator program get real, lasting value from the support they receive. Each company is paired with a Venture Partner (VP), a dedicated advisor who works with them for 12–15 months, guiding them through their growth journey. This role owns that relationship: making sure VP calls happen on schedule, cover the right ground, and, most importantly, actually lead to change inside the company.

It also plays an active part in Sprint, a focused 90-day period of hands-on support that companies go through early in the program, not just tracking whether it's on schedule, but assessing whether it's genuinely delivering value, and stepping in when it isn't.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Manage the Venture Partner Relationship**

* Make sure every company has an active, engaged VP throughout their 12–15 month journey with us.
* Track that a new company's first two calls with their VP happen on time and result in a clear plan for what the company needs to work on.
* Review that plan for quality, and confirm the company is on board with it.

**Track Calls & Follow-Through**

* Make sure VPs check in with companies at the mid-point and end of each work cycle, and that these calls are properly documented.
* Ensure regular check-in calls are happening in between.
* Check whether companies are actually acting on what the VP recommends, this is the real measure of whether the relationship is working.

**Manage Feedback**

* Regularly ask companies how their VP relationship is going.
* If something isn't working, raise it with the VP directly and help course correct.
* Be the first point of contact if a company or VP needs something to change.

**Drive Sprint Excellence**

* Keep an eye on whether a company's first support sprint is on track and finishing on time.
* Go beyond paperwork: assess whether the sprint is genuinely helping the company make progress, not just hitting scheduled milestones.
* Flag quality issues or a sprint that's off-track to the assigned expert or the Head of Portfolio Success, and help course correct.
* Make sure basic sprint paperwork, like the kickoff document, is completed.
* Feed sprint details, like hiring numbers or funding raised, into shared reports.

**Keep Records & Reporting**

* Maintain simple, accurate dashboards tracking VP calls and sprint status for every company.
* Flag any issues or bottlenecks to the Head of Portfolio Success.

**Key Outcomes:**

* Onboarding calls with new companies completed, with a plan the company agrees to.
* Mid-point and closing calls completed and documented, every cycle.
* Regular check-in calls happening and tracked.
* Companies acting on what their VP recommends.
* Feedback collected and relationship issues resolved.
* Sprint paperwork and timelines on track.
* Sprint quality and value assessed, with issues flagged and addressed.
* Company data, hiring, funding, next steps, accurate and up to date.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* 6–10 years in program management, client success, or relationship management; startup, impact, or development sector experience preferred.
* Comfortable managing long, ongoing relationships (12+ months), not just short projects.
* Experience working with external advisors, consultants, or mentors.
* Good at judging whether a conversation or piece of delivery work is actually landing, and coaching people to improve it.
* Comfortable with dashboards and tracking tools.
* Strong communicator, equally comfortable with founders and senior advisors.
* Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable with a role that will evolve as the team grows.

title: Solution Implementation Manager
description:
LevelBlue reduces risk and builds lasting resilience so organizations can innovate and advance their mission with confidence. As the world’s most analyst-recognized and largest pure-play managed security services provider, LevelBlue elevates client outcomes that matter: stronger defense, faster response, and sustained business continuity. LevelBlue combines AI-powered security operations, advanced threat intelligence, and elite human expertise to provide the most comprehensive portfolio of strategic advisory, managed security, offensive security, and incident response services.
  
  
Working Model: Hybrid / On-call flexibility required (including occasional out-of-hours support)
  
  
Working Time: 9.00 am – 5.30 pm US EST
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly motivated Solution Implementation Manager (SIM) to lead the onboarding, delivery, and implementation of Managed Security Services (MSS) for enterprise customers. This role combines technical project delivery, customer engagement, and security solution enablement, ensuring successful deployment of complex network and security services. The SIM acts as the primary point of coordination across customers, engineering teams, and vendors, with a strong focus on on-time delivery, service quality, and customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end implementation and onboarding of MSS solutions across customer environments
* Gather, analyze, and validate customer technical and business requirements
* Translate requirements into solution designs and implementation plans in collaboration with engineering teams
* Coordinate and manage deployment activities including ordering, provisioning, configuration, and testing
* Act as the primary customer-facing interface during implementation lifecycle
* Ensure successful integration of firewall, SASE, and SD-WAN solutions into customer environments
* Track and manage project milestones, risks, and dependencies to ensure timely delivery
* Drive issue resolution and escalation management across internal teams and vendors
* Maintain clear documentation, reporting, and status communication with stakeholders
* Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery processes and automation

**Core Technical Expertise**
Network & Security Fundamentals
  
  
**Strong Understanding Of**

* TCP/IP, ports, and protocols
* Routing (BGP, OSPF) and WAN technologies
* LAN/WAN architectures and network design fundamentals

Security & Network Technologies
  
  
**Experience With Enterprise Security Solutions**

* Firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, Check Point)
* VPN technologies (IPsec / SSL VPN)
* NAT, segmentation, and policy-based security Secure Access & Cloud-Delivered Security

**Delivery & Project Management Skills**

* Strong experience in technical project delivery / service implementation
* Ability to manage multiple parallel customer deployments
* Solid understanding of:
* Project lifecycle management
* Risk and dependency management
* Vendor and stakeholder coordination

**Professional Skills**

* Excellent customer-facing communication and stakeholder management
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
* Ability to translate technical concepts into customer-friendly language
* High attention to detail with strong ownership and accountability mindset
* Self-driven and proactive with the ability to work in a global environment

**Qualifications**

* 3–5+ years of experience in:
* Network/security implementation, service delivery, or project management roles
* Experience delivering firewalls or managed security services is highly preferred

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Cisco (CCNA / CCNP)
* ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management certification
* Project Management certifications (PMP, Prince2) – advantage
* Vendor certifications (Palo Alto, Fortinet) – advantage

**Education**

* BCA / B.Tech graduates or candidates with relevant qualifications in cybersecurity, information technology or related fields.

This role is open to candidates legally authorized to work in India. At LevelBlue, including teams that previously operated as Trustwave, we support flexible work and bring people together in person for key moments based on role, team, and business needs.
  
  
LevelBlue is committed to a culture of respect, inclusion, and equal opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other status protected under applicable law.
  
  
To all agencies: Please do not contact LevelBlue employees outside of the Talent Acquisition team. LevelBlue’s policy is to only accept resumes from agencies through its approved agency process and with a valid agreement in place. Any resume submitted outside this process will be considered the property of LevelBlue, and no fee will be paid if a candidate is hired from such a submission.

title: Strategic Account Manager
description:
**Account Manager –Digital Factory Solutions**

**Your mission**

As an Account Manager, you are the trusted sales and technical advisor for our customers and prospects throughout the sales process. You translate complex manufacturing challenges into compelling, end-to-end solution proposals and architectures across the Logility digital factory portfolio.

From shopfloor connectivity to AI-enabled manufacturing operations, you show decision-makers how our solutions create measurable value: more resilient operations, better planning, empowered workers and connected data across IT and OT.

**Your responsibilities**

* Lead sales & pre-sales activities for logility’s digital factory solutions in India.
* Carry the quota for digital factory solutions in India and work with solution experts across sales engagements.
* Lead technical discovery with prospects and customers; understand their production processes, business priorities, system landscape and transformation roadmap.
* Work with the SMEs to present a tailored solution across our portfolio:
* **MOM Core:**
  MES, APS, QMS, LIMS, logistics, EAM and TPM
* **Connected Worker:**
  digital work instructions, guidance, terminals, shift books, checklists and workforce management
* **Supervisory:**
  SCADA, HMI, alarm management, historian, batch operations and operations portals
* **Platform & Edge Connectors:**
  cloud services, authorization, event bus/orchestration, MCP connectivity, ERP and IT/OT integration
* **AI Core:**
  semantic, agentic and predictive capabilities
* Deliver engaging product demonstrations, workshops, proof-of-value concepts and technical presentations for operational, IT and executive stakeholders.
* Develop convincing solution proposals, scope statements and technical responses for RFPs/RFIs together with Pre-Sales SMEs, Product Management and Consulting teams.
* Quantify the operational and commercial value of proposed solutions, linking use cases to relevant customer KPIs.
* Act as the technical lead in complex sales opportunities and support account strategy, stakeholder management and deal progression.
* Build trusted relationships with manufacturing leaders, plant managers, operations teams, IT/OT architects and C-level stakeholders.
* Share market feedback and customer requirements with Product Management to help shape the future of our portfolio.
* Represent logility at customer events, trade fairs and industry forums.

**Your profile**

* 10+ years of experience in Sales or Pre-Sales for industrial software. We are open to a Pre-sales background as long as you are willing to embrace a quota carrying role.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and digital manufacturing environments, ideally across several areas such as MES/MOM, APS, quality management, SCADA, IIoT, connected worker or supply chain planning.
* Experience designing integrated IT/OT architectures and explaining data flows between shopfloor systems, ERP, cloud services and enterprise applications.
* Confidence in leading discovery workshops and translating customer needs into clear, value-driven solution concepts.
* Ability to communicate equally credibly with technical experts, operational leaders and senior decision-makers.
* Commercial awareness and a pragmatic understanding of how to support complex enterprise software sales cycles.
* Excellent presentation and storytelling skills, including live software demonstrations.
* Good English language skills.
* Willingness to travel within India and occasionally internationally.

**What makes this role special**

This is a startup region within a well-established software organization. You will not be limited to a single product. You will help industrial companies connect the full manufacturing value chain—from the edge and the shopfloor to planning, quality, operations and AI-enabled decision-making—and turn this breadth into clear, practical customer value. You will get to work with the best global SMEs in this area to solve complex customer problems in industrial manufacturing.

title: Quick Commerce Manager
description:
We are looking for a Quick Commerce Manager to own and scale our presence on quick commerce platforms (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BB Now, etc.).

This role sits at the intersection of growth, operations, and execution, driving GMV, availability, visibility, and profitability across Q-commerce channels while ensuring

seamless coordination with platform teams, HM supply teams, and channel partners for operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Platform s Account Management**

·       Own end-to-end performance across quick commerce platforms

·       Manage platform accounts, business planning, and overall account health

·       Act as the primary point of contact with platform category, ops, and growth teams

·       Manage onboarding, expansion, and day-to-day execution across dark stores

·       Ensure appointments and review meetings with HM teams and channel teams are scheduled and completed on time

·       Coordinate closely with HM supply teams to ensure appointment dates are planned and executed on an ASAP basis

·       Prepare and maintain account-wise business reports and PCL reports for management review

2. Growth s Revenue

·       Drive GMV growth through assortment expansion, pricing, and visibility levers

·       Plan and execute platform-led campaigns, app placements, and promos

·       Optimize ROAS and contribution margin for Q-commerce channels

·       Monitor account-level profitability and performance metrics

3. Assortment s Availability

·       Decide ideal Q-commerce assortment by city / dark store

·       Ensure high fill rates, in-stock %, and low cancellation rates

·       Work closely with supply chain and warehouse teams to forecast demand

·       Ensure GRN (Goods Receipt Note) processes happen on time to avoid operational delays

·       Monitor stock levels proactively and maintain healthy inventory availability across all dark stores

·       Ensure minimal to zero RTV (Return to Vendor) through efficient stock planning and execution

4. Pricing s Promotions

·       Manage platform pricing, discounts, and funding negotiations

·       Track promo performance and optimize for scale vs profitability

·       Monitor competitor pricing and platform benchmarks

5. Operations s Execution

·       Solve operational issues impacting SLA, delivery time, or customer experience

·       Track and improve key metrics: fill rate, OSA, cancellation %, refund %, ratings

·       Ensure compliance with platform SOPs and service levels

·       Drive strong coordination between operations, warehouse, supply chain, and platform teams for smooth execution

6. Data s Reporting

·       Own weekly/monthly business reviews with platforms

·       Analyze cohort-level and city-level performance

·       Identify insights and growth opportunities from platform data

·       Prepare MIS, account performance dashboards, and monthly PCL reports

·       Track revenue, margins, investments, claims, and profitability across accounts

Key Metrics You’ll Own

·       GMV C Revenue

·       Contribution Margin / ROAS

·       Fill Rate C In-Stock %

·       Cancellation C Refund Rates

·       App Visibility C Share of Shelf

·       GRN Timeliness

·       RTV Reduction C Inventory Health

·       Account-wise PCL Performance

title: Partner Success Manager
description:
**About Kinaxis**
Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
  
  
In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
  
  
Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
  
  
Location
  
  
India
  
  
**About The Role**
The
**Partner Success Manager**
is accountable for helping Kinaxis value added reseller (VAR) partners build productive, scalable, and predictable businesses around Kinaxis solutions. The role connects partner enablement, operating discipline, pipeline governance, and alliance management so that partners are equipped to create demand, progress opportunities, close business, and deliver a consistent customer experience.
  
  
This is a hands-on orchestration role. The Partner Success Manager works across VAR leadership, partner sellers and solution consultants, Kinaxis sales, pre-sales, marketing, services, customer success, operations, and legal teams. The successful candidate combines strong partner relationships with rigorous execution and uses data to identify risks, remove barriers, and improve partner performance.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Develop and manage role-based partner enablement, onboarding, certification, product training, and ongoing knowledge programs.
* Assess partner capabilities, identify readiness gaps, and drive remediation plans with clear milestones and ownership.
* Ensure partners can effectively position Kinaxis solutions, qualify opportunities, and leverage Kinaxis resources.
* Drive adoption of approved tools, processes, programs, and new product/solution launches.
* Establish and improve partner delivery readiness and standards to ensure consistent implementation quality and customer outcomes.
* Manage partner operations, governance, business reviews, pipeline cadence, scorecards, records, approvals, and action tracking.
* Partner with VAR sales leaders to build account plans, campaigns, qualified pipeline, and revenue opportunities.
* Lead pipeline reviews, monitor opportunity progression and CRM hygiene, and coordinate internal resources to advance priority deals.
* Analyze pipeline and sales performance metrics to identify risks and drive corrective actions.
* Build strong executive and functional relationships and develop joint business plans with partners.
* Align Kinaxis and partner stakeholders on priorities, responsibilities, investments, and execution.
* Identify opportunities to expand partner capabilities, market coverage, industry reach, and geographic presence.
* Represent partner needs internally while balancing customer outcomes and Kinaxis business priorities.

**Education Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

What we are looking for
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in partner management, channel sales or partner operations.
* Experience working with VARs, system integrators, software partners, or indirect go-to-market models.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software sales cycles, pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, and partner economics.
* Ability to translate strategy into actionable plans, measurable milestones, and effective execution across stakeholders.
* Strong relationship management, communication, presentation, facilitation, and executive engagement skills.
* Strong analytical capabilities with proficiency in CRM, reporting, collaboration, and productivity tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions and functions with sound judgment and attention to detail.

title: Senior Manager - Card Portfolio Optimization Consulting, VCA X
description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Team Summary
  
  
Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.
  
  
VCA-X is VCA's global delivery capability, designed to scale high-value solutions across Regions through multidisciplinary teams, common delivery standards, AI-enabled assets, and continuous learning from delivery. Working in partnership with Regional teams and Practice Areas, VCA-X enables consistent, efficient, and scalable delivery while maintaining client and market relevance.
  
  
Specialist & Consulting Delivery is a core pillar of the VCA-X operating model. It provides the specialist expertise, consulting delivery capacity, consulting leadership, and quality oversight required to ensure VCA-X delivers credible, consistent, and client-ready outputs.
  
  
The role operates as one of three core delivery leadership pillars within VCA-X, alongside Program Management and Data & Analytics Delivery.
  
  
**Purpose**

* Primary focus: Own and drive portfolio strategy — lifting acquisition, activation, engagement, and incremental spend across credit and debit card portfolios.
* Core expertise: Cards portfolio optimization strategy, customer lifecycle management (CLM), and campaign management (design, targeting), with strong familiarity with payments industry rules and card-network/regulatory guidelines.

**Responsibilities**
Portfolio Strategy and Performance:
  
  

* Develop and refine end-to-end strategies to improve KPIs: acquisition, activation, usage, spend per active, retention, cross-/up-sell, attrition reduction, credit losses, and ROI.
* Diagnose performance drivers and recommend segment-level interventions by lifecycle stage.

**Customer Lifecycle Management**

* Design journeys for onboarding, early engagement, habituation, maturation, retention/win-back; define treatments and test plans (A/B and multivariate).
* Identify friction points and opportunities to accelerate first-use, repeat use, and long-term engagement across digital and partner/merchant channels.

**Campaign Strategy, Design, And Execution**

* Translate portfolio objectives into campaign strategies: offer constructs, eligibility, targeting rules, suppression logic, and measurement frameworks.

**Insights, Analytics, And Forecasting**

* Drive analytics that size opportunities and forecast impact (propensity, uplift, CLV, attrition, spend elasticities); own a disciplined test-and-learn roadmap.
* Craft clear documentation and executive-ready presentations that turn findings into decisions for senior stakeholders.

**Thought Leadership And Team Contribution**

* Track market trends (rewards, interchange, merchant offers, embedded finance, tokenization, BNPL, digital wallets) and turn them into portfolio interventions.
* Build the playbooks, benchmarks, and frameworks that become the reference standard for portfolio optimization across every market — not a one-off deliverable, but the thing other markets build on.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 8-12 years in cards/payments, banking, or consulting with hands-on ownership of cards portfolio optimization, lifecycle programs, and campaign management.
* 2-4 years of Experience managing people, capacity, and multiple concurrent engagements.
* Experience with offer optimization, rewards strategy, merchant-funded offers, and partnerships.
* Familiarity with credit risk fundamentals (underwriting policy, line management) and their interaction with spend growth strategies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in payments, banking, financial services, consulting, or another data-intensive industry.
* Experience with GenAI, agentic workflows, prompt-based systems, or AI-assisted analytics.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to craft executive-ready presentations and translate complex analytics into clear business decisions.
* Strong project management; ability to run multiple initiatives, set priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment with disciplined documentation.
* Define the methodology, don't just execute one — thrive in a delivery model where the standard for this capability area is still being built, and where your judgment sets it.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Cluster Manager
description:
**Role: Customer Experience Manager (CEM) – Coliving**

**Zolo | Coliving**

**Own the cluster. Drive performance. Deliver consistent experience.**

**Why this role exists**

Zolo’s coliving business operates at scale across multiple properties in each city.

While individual properties are managed by on-ground teams, consistent performance across occupancy, customer experience, and profitability depends on strong cluster-level ownership.

Each cluster needs a leader who ensures:

* Properties are full and revenue targets are met
* Customer experience is consistent and NPS remains high
* Teams are trained, disciplined, and aligned
* Issues are identified early and resolved quickly

This role exists to ensure that a cluster of 10–20 properties runs with control, consistency, and accountability — delivering both strong business outcomes and great customer experience.

If the CEM is strong, the cluster performs predictably and improves continuously.

If the CEM is weak, performance drops, issues repeat, and teams lose direction.

**Your mandate is clear**

* Own occupancy, NPS, and profitability across your cluster
* Drive execution discipline and SOP adherence across all properties
* Build, train, and manage a strong on-ground team
* Identify and solve operational and customer experience issues
* Use data and numbers to drive decisions and improvements
* Ensure properties are audit-ready and consistently maintained

This is not a coordination role.

It is full ownership of cluster performance and outcomes.

**About Zolo**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.

Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation by partnering deeply with property owners who think long term.

**What you will be responsible for**

1. Own Cluster Performance & Business Outcomes

* Take full accountability for occupancy, revenue, and margins
* Track property-level performance metrics regularly
* Identify underperforming properties and drive improvement
* Ensure consistent achievement of targets across cluster

2. Drive Execution Discipline & SOP Adherence

* Ensure all properties follow defined SOPs and checklists
* Conduct regular reviews with ACEMs and property teams
* Build structured routines for daily, weekly, and monthly tracking
* Ensure consistency in execution across all properties

3. Lead & Develop On-Ground Teams

* Manage ACEMs, property managers, and housekeeping teams
* Train teams on customer experience, processes, and standards
* Identify performance gaps and take corrective actions
* Build a motivated, disciplined, and accountable team

4. Ensure Customer Experience & Manage Escalations

* Track NPS and customer feedback across properties
* Handle escalations and ensure quick resolution
* Drive root cause analysis and prevent repeat issues
* Ensure consistent guest/resident experience across cluster

5. Use Data & Numbers to Drive Decisions

* Track key metrics like occupancy, revenue, and cost
* Use data to identify trends and problem areas
* Take action based on numbers, not assumptions
* Drive performance improvements through data-led decisions

6. Audit Properties & Maintain Control

* Conduct regular property audits (hygiene, operations, processes)
* Identify gaps and ensure timely closure
* Maintain high standards across all properties
* Ensure properties are always audit-ready

**What success looks like after 6–12 months**

* Cluster consistently meets occupancy and revenue targets
* High and stable NPS across all properties
* Strong SOP adherence and execution consistency
* Reduced escalations and faster issue resolution
* Well-trained, motivated, and accountable team
* Clear visibility and control over all properties

The cluster runs with discipline, predictability, and strong performance.

**Who this role is for**

You will likely thrive here if:

* You take ownership of outcomes across multiple locations
* You enjoy managing teams and driving performance
* You are disciplined and believe in structured execution
* You are comfortable working with numbers and targets
* You can handle pressure and make decisions on-ground
* You want to grow into larger operational leadership roles

**Experience we value**

* 1–3 years of experience in operations / multi-unit environments
* Experience managing teams (directly or indirectly)
* Exposure to customer-facing environments
* Basic understanding of business metrics (occupancy, revenue, cost)
* Strong execution and follow-up discipline

Hospitality experience is not mandatory. Ownership, leadership, and execution discipline are critical.

**The impact you will have**

* You directly influence revenue, occupancy, and profitability
* You shape customer experience across multiple properties
* You build and develop on-ground teams
* You ensure operational consistency at scale

**Why join now**

Zolo is scaling its coliving business aggressively across cities.

Cluster-level execution and leadership will define success.

This role is a critical stepping stone to larger city and business leadership roles.

If you believe in ownership, discipline, and driving outcomes at scale — this is the right role.

To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. title: Data Migration Manager
description:
**External Job Ad**
****Data Migration Manager****
**Amazing Career Moments Happen Here**
Applied Systems, Inc., a worldwide leader in insurance technology, is currently searching for a Data Migration Manager to lead a team within our Data Services organization. This role is responsible for the people leadership, delivery oversight, and client-facing communication needed to ensure that customer data migrations from competitor and legacy systems into Applied Systems SaaS products are executed seamlessly, on time, and with a high standard of quality and customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a people leader within Data Services, the Manager owns the team's delivery outcomes end to end — from understanding what each customer expects and why, to translating those expectations into the technical work the team needs to complete, to confirming the outcome meets the customer's requirements. The Manager oversees a team of Data Migration Engineers, coaching and guiding their day-to-day work, while personally attending customer meetings during US hours to represent Data Services, answer questions in real time, and build trust with the customer directly.
  
  
This role works closely with a US-based Relationship Manager who coordinates with the India-based teams across multiple workstreams. The Data Migration Manager partners with this Relationship Manager on project status, customer sentiment, risk escalation, and resourcing, ensuring the two roles present a unified, well-coordinated front to the customer.
  
  
This role operates within a global, Follow the Sun delivery model. To attend customer meetings in US time and to keep migrations moving seamlessly across regions and time zones, this position requires willingness to work a night shift aligned with US business hours.
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Data Migration Engineers, setting clear expectations, providing regular feedback, and supporting career growth
* Own team performance management, including workload planning, capacity and resourcing decisions, and day-to-day people management (attendance, conduct, goal-setting, and performance reviews)
* Attend customer meetings during US business hours, serving as the primary point of contact for customers — especially US-based clients — providing regular status updates and managing expectations
* Understand each assigned migration project end to end: what the customer expects, why they expect it, and what the team needs to do — technically and operationally — to meet those expectations, translating customer requirements into clear direction for the team
* Work closely with the US-based Relationship Manager who liaises with the India teams across multiple engagements, aligning on project status, customer sentiment, risks, and priorities so both roles speak with one voice to the customer
* Oversee assigned migration projects at a program level, tracking timelines, dependencies, and deliverables, and stepping in to unblock the team or escalate issues before they impact the customer
* Act as an escalation point for complex, sensitive, or at-risk migrations, working cross-functionally with Onboarding and Success Services, Development, Operations, Solution Services, and Support to resolve issues quickly
* Support and reinforce the global Follow the Sun delivery model, ensuring smooth handoffs, clear documentation, and continuity of work across regions and time zones, including during night shift hours
* Communicate project status, risks, and outcomes clearly to both technical team members and non-technical stakeholders, including customer contacts, the Relationship Manager, and internal leadership
* Champion standardized, repeatable processes and best practices across the team; identify opportunities to improve migration quality, speed, and the overall customer experience
* Partner with leadership on staffing, training, and tooling needs as Data Services processes and platforms (including cloud-based platforms such as BigQuery and emerging automation/AI-assisted tooling) continue to evolve
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen Data Services delivery capabilities, tooling, and customer outcomes

****What You'll Need to Succeed****

* Proven experience managing, leading, or mentoring a technical team, ideally within a services, IT, or software delivery environment
* Excellent communication skills — written and verbal — with demonstrated ability to build rapport and manage expectations with clients, especially customers based in the United States
* Ability to understand a project end to end — grasping customer requirements and business context well enough to translate them into clear technical and operational direction for the team
* Working knowledge of data migration, ETL, or database concepts (for example, data extraction, transformation, data quality, and SQL fundamentals) sufficient to guide a technical team and speak credibly with customers
* Comfort working closely with a Relationship Manager or similar counterpart, coordinating on status, risk, and customer sentiment so the customer experiences one consistent point of view
* Willingness and ability to work a night shift schedule, including attending customer meetings in US time, to support the global Follow the Sun delivery model
* Strong people management skills, including experience with performance feedback, coaching, conflict resolution, and team motivation
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and priorities while remaining calm, organized, and customer-focused under pressure
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability, balanced with the ability to align the team to shared standards, processes, and delivery goals
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline

****Additionally, You May Have****

* Prior experience in a Data Migration, ETL, or data services delivery role before moving into management
* Experience managing distributed or global teams across multiple time zones
* Experience working alongside a client-facing Relationship Manager, Account Manager, or similar role on shared accounts
* Exposure to cloud data platforms (such as Google Cloud Platform / BigQuery) or automation and AI-assisted tooling used in migration delivery
* Experience using Jira, SharePoint, or similar tools to track team workload, manage projects, and report on delivery status
* Experience presenting to or managing relationships with enterprise or SaaS customers

title: EAFS IS Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**EisnerAmper | Fund Services**
**Investor Services Manager**
**Position Overview**
Investors judge a fund by the quality of every interaction they have with it: how quickly a subscription is processed, how clearly a capital call is explained, and how accurately a quarterly statement reflects their position. The Investor Services Manager owns that experience.
  
  
In this role, you lead the team responsible for investor onboarding, anti-money laundering and know-your-customer (AML/KYC) review, capital activity processing, and investor reporting across a portfolio of private equity, credit, real estate, venture, and hedge fund clients. You act as the day-to-day escalation point for fund managers and their limited partners, and you work with fund accounting, compliance, and technology colleagues to keep investor records accurate and investor communications timely.
  
  
This is a client-facing middle management role, you will be expected to set service standards and take responsibility for the accuracy of the investor register.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Investor Onboarding and Due Diligence**

* Oversee end-to-end investor onboarding, including subscription document review, side letter tracking, and entry of investor data into the fund administration platform.
* Review AML/KYC and Customer Identification Program files for completeness and escalate exceptions to compliance, including politically exposed person and sanctions screening results.
* Confirm accredited investor, qualified purchaser, and qualified client status is documented in line with each fund's offering terms.
* Coordinate FATCA and Common Reporting Standard (CRS) self-certification collection and maintain supporting tax documentation such as Forms W-8 and W-9.
* Maintain the investor register and legal entity data so that ownership, commitments, and contact records stay accurate across systems.

**Capital Activity and Transaction Processing**

* Prepare, review, and release capital call and distribution notices.
* Track funding status, follow up on late contributions, and support the default and remedy process when a limited partner fails to fund.
* Review subscriptions, redemptions, transfers, rebalances, and equalization calculations for open-ended and closed-ended structures.
* Verify bank instructions through callback and other fraud prevention controls before any payment is released.
* Reconcile investor-level capital account balances against fund accounting records and resolve differences before reporting deadlines.

**Investor Reporting and Communications**

* Administer the investor portal: user provisioning, document posting, entitlement review, and access certification.
* Perform AMLCO, FATCA/CRS and other periodic reporting.
* Respond to limited partner inquiries and due diligence questionnaires within agreed service levels, and coordinate responses with the client where judgment is required.
* Support the annual Schedule K-1 and K-3 distribution process in coordination with the tax team.

**Client Service and Relationship Management**

* Serve as the primary investor services contact for an assigned group of fund clients and their investor relations teams.
* Assist leadership and clients on onboarding of new funds and new clients, including data migration, review of governing documents, and design of the service delivery model.
* Track service level agreement performance, prepare service review materials, and present results in client meetings.
* Identify recurring pain points and propose changes that reduce turnaround time or manual effort.

**Team Leadership and Development**

* Assist the leadership in workload allocation, capacity planning, and coverage across reporting and capital activity peaks.
* Support the leadership in team members’ career development and training plans.

**Controls, Technology, and Process Improvement**

* Maintain documented procedures and confirm that four-eyes review, segregation of duties, and approval controls operate as designed.
* Support SOC 1 examinations, internal audits, and client due diligence reviews by preparing evidence and responding to testing requests.
* Identify manual steps suitable for automation and work with technology colleagues on requirements, testing, and rollout.
* Escalate control breakdowns, errors, and near misses promptly, and track remediation to closure.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, economics, business administration, or related field.
* Eight or more years of investor services, transfer agency, fund administration, or private fund investor relations experience.
* Two or more years of direct supervisory experience or demonstrated experience leading a workstream and reviewing others' work.
* Working knowledge of private fund structures, limited partnership agreements, capital calls, distributions, and capital account mechanics.
* Familiarity with AML/KYC requirements, FATCA, and CRS as they apply to pooled investment vehicles.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and large data set reconciliation.
* Demonstrated accuracy under deadline pressure, with a record of catching errors before they reach investors.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills suitable for direct contact with institutional investors and high-net-worth individuals.

**Preferred**

* Experience with fund administration or investor portal platforms.
* Hands-on experience in setting up and processing wire transfers/payments through online banking platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Letter of Authorization (LOA) processing and the ability to ensure compliance with applicable banking regulations and internal controls.
* Exposure to offshore structures in the Cayman Islands, British Virgin Islands, and to the related regulatory reporting.
* Experience supporting a fund launch or client migration from another administrator.
* Working knowledge of ILPA reporting templates and institutional investor due diligence practices.
* Data tooling skills such as Power BI, Alteryx, SQL, or Python for reconciliation and reporting.
* Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) ACAMS

Preferred Location:
  
  
Bangalore

title: Customer Operations - Lead
description:

title: Corporate Alliances & Outreach Manager
description:
**Reports to:**
CEO

**Experience:**
Minimum 8 years

**About Miror**

Miror is an integrated midlife women's health platform built for Indian women aged 35 to 65. In under two years we have built India's largest menopause-focused WhatsApp community, partnered with the National Health Mission and the Indian Menopause Society, launched a nutraceutical range, and built an app that brings together symptom tracking, personalised care pathways, diagnostic links, expert consultations and AI-supported guidance. We were recognised with the Innovation in Menopause Care award at the Global Women's Health Innovation Conference 2024.

Learn more at miror.in

**Why this role exists**

Menopause is the largest unaddressed gap in Indian corporate health benefits. Women in their forties and fifties are usually at the most senior point of their careers, and unmanaged symptoms show up on the employer's side as attrition, absenteeism and quiet withdrawal from leadership tracks. Very few Indian employers have anything in place for it.

Míror at Work is our answer, and this role owns it commercially. You will drive new business and build corporate alliances in a category with no established budget line. You will be creating one. That is the hard part and the interesting part.

**What you will own**

**New Business Development**

• Build and maintain a target account map across IT/ITES, GCCs, BFSI, consulting, retail and manufacturing employers with large or growing female workforces

• Open conversations with CHROs, HR business partners, Heads of Admin, D&I leads and wellness committee owners

• Run a structured outbound motion across LinkedIn, email, calls, HR industry forums and events

**Corporate Partnerships & Alliances**

• Build strategic alliances with benefits brokers, insurers, EAP providers and corporate wellness platforms to open new channels into employers

• Develop co-selling and referral partnerships that bring Míror at Work into existing benefits programmes

**Conversion**

• Run discovery and position Míror at Work against the client's actual retention, benefits and D&I objectives, not a generic wellness pitch

• Build proposals and commercials across annual programmes, employee seats, awareness sessions, screening camps, consultations and supplement programmes

• Bring senior leadership or medical experts into the cycle at the right moment

• Negotiate, close and hand over cleanly to the delivery team

• Carry and deliver an assigned monthly and quarterly revenue number

**Accounts & Delivery**

• Coordinate with content, clinical, product and events teams so that what was sold is what gets delivered

• Support execution of on-site health camps, awareness drives and wellness workshops

• Grow accounts past the first contract through renewals, additional sites and additional employee cohorts

**Reporting**

• Keep the CRM accurate on stage, value, owner and next action for every open opportunity

• Submit a weekly pipeline and performance report to management

• Feed field objections and pricing signals back to marketing and product

**What good looks like**

• First 30 days: target account and partner map built, messaging internalised, CRM structured and live

• First 90 days: qualified pipeline established, first pilot programmes and channel partnerships signed

• First 12 months: a repeatable playbook, named enterprise logos, active alliances and predictable month-on-month revenue

**Who we are looking for**

**Essential**

• Minimum 8 years in B2B sales, corporate partnerships or new business development, including at least 2 years selling into HR, People & Culture or Admin functions at Indian corporates

• Demonstrable track record of carrying and hitting a revenue target

• Experience building and managing corporate alliances or channel partnerships

• Comfort with a consultative, multi-stakeholder sale running across a 2–4 month cycle

• Strong written and spoken English, and the confidence to hold a room with a CHRO

• Disciplined CRM, pipeline hygiene and reporting habits

• Graduate in any discipline

**Preferred**

• MBA in Marketing or HR

• Existing relationships across the employee benefits ecosystem: benefits brokers, insurers, EAP providers, corporate wellness vendors

• Background in healthcare, diagnostics, insurance, pharma or wellness services

• Genuine interest in women's health. You will be talking about menopause every working day, with people who may be uncomfortable discussing it

**What we offer**

• Ownership of a category with no incumbent in India, and the freedom to build the playbook

• Direct working access to the founder and our medical advisory board

• Full support from marketing and clinical teams: decks, case studies, expert speakers, session content and post-sale programme design

title: Support Account Manager
description:

Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit 

www.saviynt.com

.

The Support Account Manager (SAM) serves as a trusted advisor and primary technical contact for key accounts who helps customers resolve issues and optimize their support experience.  SAM works with customers to understand their business goals, service history, and technical needs and helps customers reduce disruptions, improve operations, and accelerate innovation.

**WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**

  
* **Support issues**
  : Help customers resolve issues, including case and escalation management, root-cause analysis, and special projects
  
* **Provide reports**
  : Provide reports on the health of the customer's instance
  
* **Assist with upgrades:**
  Identify upgrade needs, create upgrade plans, and assist with upgrade planning
  
* **Advocate for customers:**
  Act as an escalation point for customer-submitted cases and requests
  
* **Client Relationship Management**
  : Establish and maintain strong relationships with key accounts. Act as the primary contact for customers’ inquiries, providing timely and effective solutions
  
* **Issue Resolution**
  : Address and resolve customer issues by coordinating with various departments. This includes diagnosing problems, implementing solutions, and ensuring issues are resolved to the customer's satisfaction
  
* **Customer Onboarding**
  : Guide new customers through the onboarding process, ensuring they understand how to use the company’s products or services effectively
  
* **Performance Monitoring**
  : Monitor and track customer support metrics to identify trends, areas for improvement, and potential issues. Utilize this data to enhance service delivery
  
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration**
  : Work closely with other departments such as sales, product development, and engineering to address customer needs and improve product offerings
  
* **Account Management**
  : Manage customer accounts by keeping detailed records of interactions, support tickets, and resolutions to ensure continuity and personalized service
  
* **Feedback Collection**
  : Gather and analyze customer feedback to identify areas for improvement in products or services. Report findings to relevant departments to facilitate enhancements
  
* **Proactive Engagement**
  : Anticipate customer needs and proactively reach out to offer assistance, updates, or new features that may benefit the customer
  
* **Documentation and Reporting:**
  Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and support activities. Generate reports to provide insights into customer satisfaction and support team performance. In this role, you will work closely with customers to monitor their environments, provide technical recommendations, and ensure seamless ongoing operations.   You will coordinate cross-functionally to advocate for customer needs, assist in issue resolution, and provide strategic recommendations to enhance security, performance, and operational efficiency
  
  

**WHAT YOU BRING**

  
* **Communication Skills:**
  Strong verbal and written communication skills are imperative for effectively interacting with customers and internal teams. Clarity and empathy are crucial
  
* **Problem-Solving**
  : Ability to diagnose and resolve issues efficiently and creatively, ensuring customer satisfaction
  
* **Time Management**
  : Excellent organizational skills to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously
  
* **Customer-Centric Mindset**
  : A commitment to delivering exceptional customer service and fostering positive relationships
  
* **Analytical Skills**
  : Ability to analyze customer feedback and performance metrics to identify trends and areas for improvement
  
* **Adaptability**
  : Flexibility to adapt to changing customer needs and dynamic work environments
  
* **Team Collaboration**
  : Capability to work well with cross-functional teams to resolve issues and improve customer satisfaction
  
* **Empathy and Patience**
  : Understanding customer frustrations and addressing them with patience and sensitivity
  
* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or 8+ years of experience in a related field (or equivalent work experience).Relevant industry certifications (CISSP, CISM, CISA, or IAM-related certifications) are a plus. This role is critical in ensuring customers achieve long-term success with Saviynt, driving retention, adoption, and maximum value from our platform

  

Saviynt is an amazing place to work. We are a high-growth, Platform as a Service company focused on Identity Authority to power and protect the world at work. You will experience tremendous growth and learning opportunities through challenging yet rewarding work which directly impacts our customers, all within a welcoming and positive work environment. If you're resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic environment you belong with us!

description:
**About ZOCA**
ZOCA is building products that help businesses simplify their operations, improve customer engagement, and drive growth. As we continue to scale our US SMB business, we are looking for an experienced Senior Account Manager to own the customer relationship and commercial health of a portfolio of US SMB customers.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role responsible for driving retention, expansion, customer satisfaction, and net revenue retention across an existing customer base.
  
  
**The Role**
We are looking for a Account Manager who can take complete ownership of a portfolio of US SMB customers and drive both customer outcomes and revenue growth.
  
  
You will be responsible for protecting the existing revenue base while identifying and executing opportunities to expand customer relationships through upsells, cross-sells, additional locations, product adoption, and other expansion opportunities.
  
  
The ideal candidate has deep experience in subscription SaaS account management, with a strong track record in farming, retention, expansion, and managing a high-velocity SMB customer portfolio.
  
  
This is a commercially-oriented account management role. You should be comfortable having conversations about value, renewals, pricing, product adoption, expansion, and retention — while ensuring customers have a strong overall experience with ZOCA.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
You will have direct ownership of the commercial and relationship health of your assigned customer portfolio, including:
  
  

* GRR – Gross Revenue Retention
* NRR – Net Revenue Retention
* Customer retention and churn
* Expansion revenue
* Upsell and cross-sell
* Customer satisfaction
* CSAT
* NPS
* Product adoption and engagement
* Renewal performance
* Customer relationship health

**What You'll DoCustomer Portfolio Management**

* Own a portfolio of US SMB customers and act as the primary strategic point of contact.
* Build strong, trusted relationships with business owners, operators, and key decision-makers.
* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business, goals, challenges, and use of ZOCA.
* Proactively manage customer health and identify risks before they become churn events.
* Segment and prioritize your portfolio based on revenue, growth potential, engagement, and risk.
* Establish a consistent cadence of customer engagement appropriate to the account's size, value, and health.

**Retention & Renewals**

* Own customer retention and renewal outcomes across your portfolio.
* Proactively identify customers showing signs of churn risk and develop structured save plans.
* Lead renewal conversations and address commercial, product, adoption, and relationship-related objections.
* Understand the underlying reason behind customer churn risk rather than simply reacting to cancellation requests.
* Execute effective retention strategies including value reinforcement, product adoption, stakeholder engagement, and commercial negotiation.
* Recover at-risk customers and execute churn win-backs where appropriate.
* Maintain strong visibility into upcoming renewals and potential churn.

**Expansion & Revenue Growth**

* Identify and execute opportunities to grow existing customer revenue.
* Drive upsell, cross-sell, additional locations, higher plans, and other expansion opportunities.
* Identify expansion opportunities through customer usage, business growth, product adoption, and unmet customer needs.
* Conduct commercial conversations and negotiate expansion opportunities.
* Partner with customers to identify additional ways ZOCA can create value for their business.
* Build and maintain a healthy expansion pipeline across the portfolio.
* Consistently achieve expansion and revenue targets.

**Customer Experience**

* Take ownership of overall customer satisfaction and relationship health.
* Drive improvements in CSAT and NPS across the portfolio.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and work cross-functionally to resolve them.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally.
* Partner closely with Product, Support, Sales, and Operations teams to resolve customer issues and improve the customer experience.
* Turn customer feedback into actionable insights for the broader organization.

**Data, Forecasting & Execution**

* Maintain accurate customer health, renewal, expansion, and forecast data in the CRM.
* Track GRR, NRR, churn, expansion, CSAT, NPS, and other key portfolio metrics.
* Build accurate forecasts for renewals and expansion revenue.
* Develop action plans for customers at risk and track progress against those plans.
* Identify trends across the portfolio and proactively recommend strategies to improve retention and growth.
* Use data to prioritize where to spend time across a high-volume SMB customer base.

**What We're Looking ForMust Have**

* 3-5 years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Client Management, or a similar customer-facing commercial role.
* Strong experience in B2B SaaS / subscription-based businesses.
* Proven experience managing and growing an existing customer portfolio.
* Strong hands-on experience in farming, retention, renewals, and expansion.
* Experience managing customers in the US market while working from India.
* Strong experience working with the SMB segment.
* Proven track record of owning retention and expansion targets.
* Strong understanding of GRR, NRR, churn, renewals, expansion revenue, and customer health.
* Experience managing a high-velocity customer portfolio with a large number of accounts.
* Strong commercial and negotiation skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, particularly with US-based customers.
* Ability to build relationships with business owners and senior decision-makers.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working with customer data, metrics, forecasts, and CRM systems.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to independently manage a portfolio.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience in a SaaS business with monthly or annual recurring revenue.
* Experience managing SMB customers at scale.
* Experience owning a book of business against GRR/NRR targets.
* Proven history of driving expansion through upsell and cross-sell.
* Experience with churn saves, win-backs, downgrade prevention, and renewal negotiations.
* Experience owning or influencing CSAT and NPS.
* Experience working in a high-growth startup or high-velocity SaaS environment.
* Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, or similar CRM/customer success platforms.

**What Success Looks Like**
Success in this role means growing and protecting the revenue in your portfolio while creating strong customer relationships.
  
  
**Your Key Metrics Will Include**

* GRR
* NRR
* Renewal rate
* Churn rate
* Expansion ARR / MRR
* Upsell and cross-sell revenue
* Churn saves and win-backs
* Customer health
* CSAT
* NPS
* Product adoption and engagement
* Forecast accuracy

You should be able to look at your portfolio and clearly answer:
  
  
Which customers are at risk? Why are they at risk? What am I doing about it?
  
  
Which customers have expansion potential? Why? What is the opportunity?
  
  
Which customers are healthy? How can I make them even more valuable and successful?
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate**
**You Will Thrive In This Role If You**
Think commercially: You don't view Account Management as simply servicing customers. You understand how to protect revenue and create opportunities to grow it.
  
  
Are proactive: You identify churn risk and expansion opportunities before they become obvious.
  
  
Know how to farm: You can take an existing customer relationship and systematically grow its value over time.
  
  
Are comfortable with difficult conversations: You can confidently discuss renewals, pricing, cancellations, downgrades, and commercial objections.
  
  
Are customer-obsessed: You genuinely care about customer outcomes and understand that strong retention starts with delivering value.
  
  
Are data-driven: You know your portfolio numbers and use data to prioritize your time and actions.
  
  
Operate well at scale: You can effectively manage a high-volume SMB portfolio without every account requiring a completely bespoke approach.
  
  
Take ownership: You own the outcome — whether that means saving a customer, expanding an account, improving NPS, or fixing a customer experience issue.
  
  
**Why Join ZOCA?**

* Own a significant portfolio of US SMB customers and directly influence ZOCA's recurring revenue.
* Play a critical role in building ZOCA's retention and expansion engine.
* Work in a high-velocity SaaS environment with significant opportunities to drive NRR.
* Have direct visibility into the commercial impact of your work.
* Partner closely with Sales, Product, Support, and Operations teams.
* Opportunity to grow into senior Account Management, Customer Success, or leadership roles as ZOCA scales.

**If you're an experienced SaaS Account Manager who knows how to protect revenue, grow existing accounts, and build long-term customer relationships in the US SMB market, we'd love to hear from you.**
