title: Sr. Account Manager
description:
**5 days WFO (US shift)**

**The Role**

We are looking for a Senior Account Manager who can take complete ownership of a portfolio of US SMB customers and drive both customer outcomes and revenue growth.

You will be responsible for protecting the existing revenue base while identifying and executing opportunities to expand customer relationships through upsells, cross-sells, additional locations, product adoption, and other expansion opportunities.

The ideal candidate has deep experience in subscription SaaS account management, with a strong track record in farming, retention, expansion, and managing a high-velocity SMB customer portfolio.

This is a commercially-oriented account management role. You should be comfortable having conversations about value, renewals, pricing, product adoption, expansion, and retention — while ensuring customers have a strong overall experience.

**What You'll Own**

You will have direct ownership of the commercial and relationship health of your assigned customer portfolio, including:

* GRR – Gross Revenue Retention
* NRR – Net Revenue Retention
* Customer retention and churn
* Expansion revenue
* Upsell and cross-sell
* Customer satisfaction
* CSAT
* NPS
* Product adoption and engagement
* Renewal performance
* Customer relationship health

**What You'll Do - Customer Portfolio Management**

* Own a portfolio of US SMB customers and act as the primary strategic point of contact.
* Build strong, trusted relationships with business owners, operators, and key decision-makers.
* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business, goals, challenges.
* Proactively manage customer health and identify risks before they become churn events.
* Segment and prioritize your portfolio based on revenue, growth potential, engagement, and risk.
* Establish a consistent cadence of customer engagement appropriate to the account's size, value, and health.

**Retention & Renewals**

* Own customer retention and renewal outcomes across your portfolio.
* Proactively identify customers showing signs of churn risk and develop structured save plans.
* Lead renewal conversations and address commercial, product, adoption, and relationship-related objections.
* Understand the underlying reason behind customer churn risk rather than simply reacting to cancellation requests.
* Execute effective retention strategies including value reinforcement, product adoption, stakeholder engagement, and commercial negotiation.
* Recover at-risk customers and execute churn win-backs where appropriate.
* Maintain strong visibility into upcoming renewals and potential churn.

**Expansion & Revenue Growth**

* Identify and execute opportunities to grow existing customer revenue.
* Drive upsell, cross-sell, additional locations, higher plans, and other expansion opportunities.
* Identify expansion opportunities through customer usage, business growth, product adoption, and unmet customer needs.
* Conduct commercial conversations and negotiate expansion opportunities.
* Partner with customers to identify additional ways company can create value for their business.
* Build and maintain a healthy expansion pipeline across the portfolio.
* Consistently achieve expansion and revenue targets.

**Customer Experience**

* Take ownership of overall customer satisfaction and relationship health.
* Drive improvements in CSAT and NPS across the portfolio.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and work cross-functionally to resolve them.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally.
* Partner closely with Product, Support, Sales, and Operations teams to resolve customer issues and improve the customer experience.
* Turn customer feedback into actionable insights for the broader organization.

**Data, Forecasting & Execution**

* Maintain accurate customer health, renewal, expansion, and forecast data in the CRM.
* Track GRR, NRR, churn, expansion, CSAT, NPS, and other key portfolio metrics.
* Build accurate forecasts for renewals and expansion revenue.
* Develop action plans for customers at risk and track progress against those plans.
* Identify trends across the portfolio and proactively recommend strategies to improve retention and growth.
* Use data to prioritize where to spend time across a high-volume SMB customer base.

**What We're Looking For - Must Have**

* 4–10 years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Client Management, or a similar customer-facing commercial role.
* Strong experience in B2B SaaS / subscription-based businesses.
* Proven experience managing and growing an existing customer portfolio.
* Strong hands-on experience in farming, retention, renewals, and expansion.
* Experience managing customers in the US market while working from India.
* Strong experience working with the SMB segment.
* Proven track record of owning retention and expansion targets.
* Strong understanding of GRR, NRR, churn, renewals, expansion revenue, and customer health.
* Experience managing a high-velocity customer portfolio with a large number of accounts.
* Strong commercial and negotiation skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, particularly with US-based customers.
* Ability to build relationships with business owners and senior decision-makers.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working with customer data, metrics, forecasts, and CRM systems.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to independently manage a portfolio.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience in a SaaS business with monthly or annual recurring revenue.
* Experience managing SMB customers at scale.
* Experience owning a book of business against GRR/NRR targets.
* Proven history of driving expansion through upsell and cross-sell.
* Experience with churn saves, win-backs, downgrade prevention, and renewal negotiations.
* Experience owning or influencing CSAT and NPS.
* Experience working in a high-growth startup or high-velocity SaaS environment.
* Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, or similar CRM/customer success platforms.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means growing and protecting the revenue in your portfolio while creating strong customer relationships.

**Your Key Metrics Will Include**

* GRR
* NRR
* Renewal rate
* Churn rate
* Expansion ARR / MRR
* Upsell and cross-sell revenue
* Churn saves and win-backs
* Customer health
* CSAT
* NPS
* Product adoption and engagement
* Forecast accuracy

You should be able to look at your portfolio and clearly answer:

Which customers are at risk? Why are they at risk? What am I doing about it?

Which customers have expansion potential? Why? What is the opportunity?

Which customers are healthy? How can I make them even more valuable and successful?

**The Ideal Candidate**

**You Will Thrive In This Role If You**

Think commercially: You don't view Account Management as simply servicing customers. You understand how to protect revenue and create opportunities to grow it.

Are proactive: You identify churn risk and expansion opportunities before they become obvious.

Know how to farm: You can take an existing customer relationship and systematically grow its value over time.

Are comfortable with difficult conversations: You can confidently discuss renewals, pricing, cancellations, downgrades, and commercial objections.

Are customer-obsessed: You genuinely care about customer outcomes and understand that strong retention starts with delivering value.

Are data-driven: You know your portfolio numbers and use data to prioritize your time and actions.

Operate well at scale: You can effectively manage a high-volume SMB portfolio without every account requiring a completely bespoke approach.

Take ownership: You own the outcome — whether that means saving a customer, expanding an account, improving NPS, or fixing a customer experience issue.

title: Manager, Implementation (EOR)
description:
**About Rippling**

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**

This is an exciting opportunity to be a foundational People Manager of Rippling’s Global Products Implementation team, focusing on our Employer of Record (EOR) product.

Rippling believes that we can change the way small businesses manage HR & IT programs globally. You will manage a team of Global Products Implementation Managers, who own the customer experience from project kick-off through launch. Through customer education and one-on-one advising, Implementation Managers ensure customers are set up for success with the Rippling products they have purchased.

In addition to your core role as People Manager, you will also have the opportunity to take on cross functional projects and show individual strengths, from product to client experience. Your work will ensure that our front line implementation managers are properly supported to provide a seamless implementation experience!

**Note**

* **The role requires you to work the US shift (PST)**

**What you will do**

* Own a team of Global Products Implementation Managers, located around the world and each managing a book of ~30 customer implementations.
* Support employee career growth through coaching and mentoring
* Monitor the health of our KPIs (CSAT, SLAs, etc)
* Lead your team to hit KPIs through proactive tracking and mitigation
* Serve as an escalation contact internally and externally
* Instrument and scale our Global Implementation team
* Measure the effectiveness and quality of our global products implementation experience, continuously suggesting improvements against our core KPIs
* Actively participate in hiring and onboarding of team members
* Monitor team capacity and recommend data backed (quantitative and qualitative) solutions from people to process to product
* Instrument implementation workflows and optimize process inefficiencies
* Design new processes
* Collaborate with sales on presale requirements and with CX on exit gates
* Build and document playbooks, email templates, etc - own the end to end Global products implementation workflow

**What you will need**

* Minimum of 5 years experience in implementation, technical account management, or customer success at a fast-paced SaaS company.
* Experience with end to end employee onboarding - emphasis on global employee onboarding.
* Minimum of 1 year experience as a lead or direct manager with mentorship/coaching responsibility.
* Proven project management experience delegating multiple projects simultaneously and on time in a fast-paced environment. Nothing slips through the cracks.
* Creative about finding solutions: You are relentless in searching documentation, creating documentation, asking “What if questions.” You push others to do the same.
* Confidently navigate multiple external stakeholders that can range from executives to front line staff in IT, to Operations, to HR, to Finance.

**Bonus**

* 4+ years experience in a customer-facing position within the HCM space (HR,Payroll, Benefits, ETC).
* Proficient in tools such as JIRA, SFDC, G Suite, Outreach, Mac Computers.

title: Client Partner Manager

A strong understanding of the broader digital marketing ecosystem including attribution, viewability, measurement, and competitive dynamics is essential.
  
  
Overall, this is an exciting opportunity to lead a best-in-class sales organization. The CPM will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding strategic partnerships and strengthening client retention, while ensuring the team continues to deliver market-leading service.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelors Degree educated, MBA a plus
* Deep understanding of the mobile app economy and strong passion for the evolving digital marketing landscape.
* Significant experience in online, digital, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile ecosystem and data-driven marketing environment.

* Demonstrated ability to build strong team cultures and to attract, develop, and retain top talent.
* A hands-on player-coach leadership style, with the ability to both lead strategically and actively engage in key client relationships and sales opportunities.
* Strong network and relationships across clients, agencies, and developers.
* Ability to engage and influence stakeholders across all levels from C-suite executives to day-to-day marketing planners.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to listen actively, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and clearly articulate strategic business visions internally and externally.
* Proven ability to foster collaboration and drive shared success across cross-functional teams.
* Team-first mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment while adapting to new business opportunities.
* Highly professional demeanor with a positive and solutions-oriented attitude.
* Experience in gaming app category preferred.

title: Client Partner
description:

At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Our Advertising Platforms organization enables a thriving ecosystem for content creators, publishers, and developers by helping them monetize their work while enabling users to discover high-quality content seamlessly across Apple devices. With the continued growth of Apple Ads within the App Store where a significant majority of app downloads originate from search this platform has become a critical channel for app discovery and performance marketing for iOS developers globally.

title: Digital Customer Success Manager
description:
This role sits within our Digital Customer Success team. This team exists to manage and evolve how we serve customers through digital and agentic experiences. The team helps MongoDB deliver a consistent, personalised and relevant experience using data, lifecycle programmes, automation, and human judgement where it matters most.
  
  
We are looking for a Digital Success Manager to foster high-impact customer relationships at scale by leveraging data, automation, and digital channels to deliver tailored, value-led experiences. Blending strategic insight with digital programmes, you will advance our Digital-First strategy and achieve key organizational goals.
  
  
Serving as a subject matter expert across a high volume of low-to-mid-tier accounts, you will build deep knowledge of the long tail of your assigned region, analyzing retention trends and uncovering new ways to add value. Rather than conducting traditional 1:1 meetings, you will drive customer outcomes using scalable digital check-ins, automated health-score triggers, and 1:many outreach, stepping in personally as the human-in-the-loop escalation point when judgment, nuance, or a personal touch is needed.
  
  
Because this role is still evolving, we seek an entrepreneurial self-starter who is curious, driven, and excited to take initiative, someone who is knowledgeable and excited about AI and uses it hands-on to accelerate their work, run their own research, and manage their own programmes, but also understands its limitations. In this role you will partner closely with sales and cross-functional teams to shape the future of Digital Customer Success.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram/Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Who You Are
  
  
Our ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, is passionate and knowledgeable about AI, and brings strong analytical skills paired with a deep, customer-centric mindset. You are:
  
  

* Regional Expert & Escalation Point: Deep, long-tail knowledge of your assigned region, you know the accounts, patterns, and risks well enough to be the human-in-the-loop escalation point when automated programmes need judgment or a personal touch
* AI-Native & Hands-On: Genuinely excited and knowledgeable about AI, and you use it in your day-to-day work, building your own dashboards, running your own research, and managing your own programmes rather than waiting on others to build the tooling for you
* Curious & Driven: Self-directed, endlessly curious, and always looking for the next insight, improvement, or opportunity to add value
* Independent, Yet a Great Partner: Comfortable working independently and owning your patch, but equally strong at partnering, especially with long tail sales teams, to understand customers and co-design programmes together
* Data-Driven & Analytical: Skilled at analyzing customer trends and data to unlock value and optimize customer outcomes at scale
* Digital Channels Specialist: Experienced in using scalable 1:many digital engagement models and outreach strategies to connect with customers effectively
* Strategic Thinker: Able to translate customer insights into strategic initiatives that advance Digital-First goals and drive long-term success

What You’ll Do:
  
  

* Serve as the face of Digital CS for your region, building deep knowledge of the long tail of your assigned region and acting as the key domain expert, advocate, and human-in-the-loop escalation point for digital customer success strategies in your region
* Lead customer engagement and retention through digital-first programmes, hosting 1:many interactive workshops, webinars, and targeted digital touchpoints. Drive the regional 1:many strategy for our long tail segment, stepping in with selective 1:1 interactions where appropriate to ensure high impact
* Partner closely with sales and account teams to deeply understand customers, co-design digital-first programmes together, report regional insights, and unlock enablement opportunities, improve onboarding, and mitigate churn
* Use AI tools and techniques to build your own dashboards, conduct your own research, and manage your own programmes, bringing curiosity and initiative to how you work, not just what you deliver

What You'll Bring:
  
  

* Experience: 3+ years in Customer Success or a similar role; familiarity with scaled or digital models across the onboarding and consumption phases
* AI Fluency: Genuine enthusiasm for and hands-on experience with AI tools, with a track record of using them independently to build dashboards, automate research, or manage programmes
* Mindset: Curious, driven, and entrepreneurial, comfortable building processes from scratch and developing innovative solutions that deliver measurable results, while working both independently and as a strong partner to others
* Collaboration Skills: Proven ability to work cross-functionally, particularly with sales teams, and align objectives across diverse stakeholders
* Adaptability: Comfortable navigating fast-moving shifts in scope, strategy, and goals
* Tech-Savviness: Familiarity with the tools and technologies that support digital engagement (e.g., automation tools, CRMs, CS software)
* Analytical Acumen: An ability to analyze data and extract actionable insights for program optimization

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Principal Application Engineer
description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
**Position Title**
Principle Application Engineer – Customer Excellence
  
  
**Department**
Customer Success / Customer Excellence
  
  
**Reporting To**
Head of Customer Success
  
  
**Location**
Remote / Hybrid
  
  
**Travel**
Periodic travel to customer sites, industry events, and internal planning sessions
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Customer Excellence Manager (CEM) is responsible for helping strategic customers achieve measurable business and engineering outcomes through successful adoption of our simulation and engineering software solutions.
  
  
The CEM serves as the trusted advisor and primary post-sales relationship owner, developing customer success plans, driving adoption initiatives, monitoring customer health and sentiment, and ensuring customers realize maximum value from their investment.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong CAE and engineering software knowledge with customer engagement, strategic account management, stakeholder alignment, and business acumen. This role requires close collaboration with Sales, Application Engineering, Support, Product Management, and Marketing teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes while supporting retention and long-term account growth.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Customer Success & Value Realization: Own customer success outcomes by driving product adoption, value realization, and achievement of customer business and engineering objectives throughout the customer lifecycle.
* Strategic Customer Engagement: Build trusted relationships with technical, management, and executive stakeholders, serving as a strategic advisor and advocate for customer success.
* Customer Health & Retention: Monitor customer health, adoption trends, and sentiment to proactively identify risks, develop recovery plans, and support long-term customer retention.
* Account Planning & Growth: Collaborate with Sales and Account Teams to contribute customer insights, support account planning activities, and identify opportunities for product adoption, expansion, and growth.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Coordinate activities across Sales, Application Engineering, Support, Product Management, Professional Services, and Marketing to ensure successful customer outcomes.
* Voice of the Customer: Represent customer needs and feedback within the organization, helping influence product priorities, adoption strategies, and customer experience improvements.
* Executive Business Reviews & Governance: Lead customer governance discussions and business reviews that demonstrate value, align stakeholders, identify opportunities, and strengthen strategic relationships.
* Customer Advocacy: Develop customer champions and advocates who can participate in reference programs, industry events, case studies, and other strategic engagement initiatives.

**Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Business Development, Application Engineering, Technical Consulting, Pre-Sales, or Account Management within engineering software, CAE, simulation, PLM, CAD, or related technology industries.
* Experience managing strategic customer relationships and driving long-term adoption programs.
* Experience conducting customer reviews, executive engagements, and technical discussions with multiple stakeholder levels.
* Proven history of supporting customer retention, adoption growth, and business expansion initiatives.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Strong customer-centric mindset.
* Strategic account planning and stakeholder management.
* Ability to leverage AI tools to enhance customer engagement, adoption, reporting, and productivity.
* Executive communication and presentation skills.
* Customer health and sentiment management.
* Value realization and adoption planning.
* Cross-functional leadership and influence without authority.
* Analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Strong business and commercial acumen.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Tools & Platforms
  
  

* CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
* Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight.
* Bring AI expertise
* Customer adoption and engagement analytics tools.
* Microsoft Office and collaboration platforms.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  

* Customer Outcomes: Achievement of customer success plan objectives; customer adoption and utilization growth; successful onboarding and adoption milestones.
* Customer Health: Customer health score improvements; customer sentiment and relationship strength; risk identification and mitigation effectiveness.
* Retention & Growth: Customer retention rate; contribution to Net Revenue Retention (NRR); expansion opportunities identified and supported; renewal readiness and account stability.
* Customer Advocacy: Customer references and success stories generated; product feedback submitted and acted upon; participation in advocacy and community initiatives.
* Operational & Reporting: Accurate customer planning, reporting, and cross-functional execution.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  
  
**A successful candidate will be a technically credible CAE professional who can build trusted relationships, drive customer adoption, influence cross-functional teams, manage customer sentiment, contribute to account planning, and identify business growth opportunities while ensuring customers achieve measurable engineering and business outcomes.**
**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

title: Technical Success Manager-AMS
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for an experienced Technical Success Manager (TSM) to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Manager, Technical Success Management in the Customer Success department. At Zscaler, our Customer Success Organization is a global, customer-focused team dedicated to delivering high-impact experiences and identifying innovative solutions. We leverage valuable data and research to provide expert, hands-on support starting from the implementation phase and beyond, ensuring customers achieve their goals and leverage our technology to its fullest potential.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Understand customer goals, challenges, and technical needs to align with Zscaler solutions and drive satisfaction
* Build relationships with stakeholders, conduct reviews, and identify growth opportunities
* Anticipate challenges, provide proactive recommendations, and mitigate risks
* Understand all Zscaler products and services and contribute to best practices for implementing Zscaler products in both internal and customer-facing Knowledge Bases
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Support, and Product, to deliver a seamless customer experience

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles with a blend of technical expertise and account management
* Demonstrated experience with product feature implementations and best-practice adoption
* Experience troubleshooting network issues utilizing tools such as Ping, Traceroute, and MTR across Linux, Unix, or FreeBSD operating systems
* Solid comprehension of core networking protocols including HTTP, SMTP, FTP, and DNS

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Demonstrate a proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency.
* Experience utilizing AI-powered customer success platforms or AIOps tools to analyze support sentiment, automate risk detection, and deliver predictive optimization recommendations
* Experience running discovery discussions, creating high- and low-level designs, and managing large-scale enterprise deployments or migrations for cloud security technologies like SASE, SSE, and ZTNA
* In-depth understanding of enterprise infrastructure, open-source system administration, and authentication protocols such as SAML, LDAP, and OAuth

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.
  
  
**Benefits**
Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:
  
  

* Various health plans
* Time off plans for vacation and sick time
* Parental leave options
* Retirement options
* Education reimbursement
* In-office perks, and more!

Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.
  
  
By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.

title: Territory Field Manager
description:
**Company Description**
NoBrokerHood is a technology-driven visitor, community, and finance & asset management platform designed to make life more secure and convenient for gated societies. Launched in 2018 as a subsidiary of NoBroker, India’s first prop-tech unicorn, it now manages over 25,000 societies and supports more than 4.8 million families across the country. The platform serves multiple stakeholders with dedicated interfaces for society administrators, security staff, and residents, and offers additional services such as home maintenance and property renting or selling. It also enables revenue generation for communities and partner businesses through monetization and marketplace features. Backed by certifications including Level 1 PCI-DSS, GDPR, PDPB 2019, and ISO 27001, and supported by a $5 million investment from Google, NoBrokerHood is positioned for strong growth and innovation.
  
**Role Description**
The Territory Field Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Bengaluru Area, responsible for driving adoption and performance of NoBrokerHood across assigned societies and regions. This role involves managing field operations, building relationships with society management committees and resident groups, and ensuring smooth implementation of the platform and its services. The Territory Field Manager will oversee local sales activities, coordinate customer onboarding and training, track territory performance metrics, and support revenue generation through monetization and marketplace offerings. Day-to-day responsibilities include visiting societies, conducting product demonstrations, resolving operational issues, collecting feedback, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve service quality and customer satisfaction.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret territory performance data, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Candidates should possess Business Planning skills to develop territory plans, set targets, and execute strategies aligned with overall business objectives.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to present solutions, conduct trainings, and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to handle queries, address concerns, and maintain high levels of satisfaction among societies and residents.
* Candidates should possess Sales Operations skills to manage pipelines, drive adoption, and support revenue growth within the assigned territory.
* Relevant qualifications include experience in field or territory management, preferably in SaaS, prop-tech, or community management solutions.
* Additional beneficial qualifications include a bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, proficiency in local languages, and familiarity with gated community operations.
* Ability to work independently in the field, willingness to travel within the territory, and strong organizational and time management skills are required.

To achieve its aim, Wind Pioneers is driven by its consultancy work, both in terms of providing the revenues for our continued existence, but also to provide a rich source of learning opportunities to help test and develop our approaches.
  
  
Growing a cohort of satisfied clients is key to the company achieving its long-term aim, and the
**Engineering Lead**
for Wind Pioneers will be responsible for managing various consultancy aspects of the company. It will include (though not limited to) - end to end client satisfaction and happiness, business developments across regions and helping to improve and expand the services we offer to our Clients.
  
  
**Detailed Responsibilities**
The role will broadly involve:
  
  

* Client handling from enquiry to final project delivery. Running business meetings along with Client Leads with clients across regions and understanding the scope of work and striking a deal.
* Undertaking engineering assessments, and working with project engineers to ensure the quality of project deliverables.
* Providing advice to clients to help them progress technical aspects of their projects
* Keep existing clients happy by making sure our assessments for them are in line with their expectations.
* Acting as a single point of contact for various Clients, including key Clients.
* Identifying new clients and growing the business across the world.
* Work closely on client feedback to improve overall delivery of projects.
* Provide valuable guidance to the team for better management of clients and projects.
* Close collaboration with Client Leads for job resourcing across various projects.
* Closely collaborate with Technical Lead for project management and commercial support
* Mentoring and training of team members, and coordination of cross-pollination of knowledge and ideas across the team

**Candidate Requirements**

* A passion for wind resource, and for the role renewable energy can play in mitigating climate change
* 7+ years of experience in the field and in a similar role. Also capable of independent work, and taking initiative in self- directing work projects
* Highly organised
* Detail orientated
* Confident communicator
* Great in a client-facing role and technically sound
* Able to build rapport with team and clients
* Takes great pride in quality of their work
* Always looking to improve processes, approaches
* Potential to grow with the company

**Wind Pioneers’ Offering**

* Responsibility in owning many aspects of Wind Pioneers’ consultancy activities
* Supportive environment to gain in-depth technical experience the Wind Pioneers way
* Part of a focused team with a clear vision, dedicated to making an outsized impact in the way that wind farm projects are found and evaluated
* A friendly, relaxed office environment and team culture
* Flexible working conditions
* Market-based salary along with addition of Wind Pioneers’ revenue share scheme

Skills: wind resource assessment,client management,wind energy consulting,wind data analysis,wind farm energy yield assessment

description:

About Swiggy:
  
  
Swiggy is India's leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500 cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation.
  
  
Built on the back of robust ML technology and fueled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India.
  
  
From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming a logistics hub of excellence today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
  
  
With Swiggy's New Supply and the recent launches of Swiggy Instamart, Swiggy Genie, and Guiltfree, we are consistently making waves in the market, while continually growing the opportunities we offer our people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
The Partner Success Manager / Senior Account Manager will own the post-sales relationship with restaurant partners,
  
  
ensuring successful adoption, active usage and measurable ROI. The role is central to driving partner satisfaction,
  
  
retention and revenue growth while acting as a trusted growth advisor to restaurant partners.
  
  

* Partner Onboarding & Adoption
* Own end-to-end post-sales onboarding of the product suite for assigned restaurant partners, including Digital Menu,

CRM tools, reservations and QR-based ordering.
  
  

* Coordinate product setup, POS integration, QR deployment and account configuration, including menus, floor

plans, shifts and outlet details.
  
  

* Conduct structured product walkthroughs, demos and staff training to ensure smooth go-live within defined

timelines.
  
  

* Partner Success & Relationship Management
* Act as the primary point of contact for restaurant partners in the city.
* Build strong, long-term relationships with owners, decision-makers and outlet managers.
* Regularly engage partners through check-ins, reviews and on-ground visits.
* Driving ROI & Business Growth
* Help restaurant partners translate product feature usage into measurable business outcomes.
* Drive higher AOV/table value through upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
* Improve repeat visits using CRM and targeted campaigns.
* Enable better table utilization and demand shaping.
* Reduce operational friction through QR-led ordering and billing.
* Track and communicate ROI metrics such as adoption depth, repeat-rate uplift, campaign performance and

menu-led revenue impact.
  
  

* Performance Monitoring & Reviews
* Conduct monthly and quarterly business reviews (MBRs/QBRs) with partners.
* Analyze partner performance data and recommend actionable improvements.
* Identify early warning signs of churn and proactively resolve issues.
* Expansion & Feature Adoption Support
* Identify opportunities to increase depth of usage across available product features.
* Train restaurant staff on new workflows and maintain adoption through repeat training and SOPs, especially during staff changes.
* Support expansion across multiple outlets by demonstrating value and sharing best practices.

Key Success Metrics (KPIs)
  
  

* Product feature adoption and activation rate
* Partner retention and churn reduction
* Usage frequency across product features
* Partner ROI and satisfaction metrics, including NPS
* Revenue expansion from existing partners

Experience & Qualifications
  
  

* 4–7 years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Partner Success or B2B relationship

management.
  
  

* Prior experience in F&B;, hospitality, SaaS, CRM, POS or restaurant technology is highly preferred.

title: AgriTech Customer Success Manager
description:
Elevatoz is a Bangalore-based B2B SaaS company that builds and operates enterprise platforms for product traceability and integrated loyalty program management. Our platforms help brands authenticate products, track their movement through complex distribution networks, and engage channel partners, influencers, farmers and customers through configurable loyalty, rewards and engagement programs.

Our platforms are used by leading brands across Agri, Retail, Manufacturing, Construction and other sectors, giving us cross-industry depth in building scalable, outcome-driven SaaS solutions that strengthen stakeholder visibility, product movement and relationships, and deliver measurable business impact.

**Job Description: Customer Success Manager – SaaS Platforms (AgriTech Traceability & Loyalty)**

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Experience:**
8–12 years

**Function:**
SaaS Account Management, Customer Success & Platform Adoption

**Industry:**
B2B SaaS – AgriTech Traceability & Loyalty Platforms

**Level:**
Senior leadership role; leads the AgriTech SaaS account management and customer success team

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to own the AgriTech customer portfolio for our traceability and loyalty SaaS platforms. You will be accountable for the full customer lifecycle on our platforms, from onboarding and time-to-value through adoption, renewal and expansion, and for the recurring revenue the AgriTech portfolio generates.

This is a leadership role. You will build and lead the account management and customer success team for the AgriTech vertical, act as executive sponsor for strategic customers, and serve as the senior escalation point for platform, adoption and commercial issues.

The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of the agriculture and agri-input ecosystem with SaaS commercial maturity, team leadership and strong platform fluency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Portfolio Ownership & Customer Leadership**

▪ Own the AgriTech customer portfolio across both the traceability and loyalty platforms and be the senior point of accountability for platform adoption, customer outcomes and recurring revenue.

▪Build and sustain senior relationships across customer organizations, including sales, marketing, supply chain, IT and operations leadership, positioning our platforms as core business infrastructure.

▪
Maintain a portfolio-level view of ARR, renewals, net revenue retention, churn risk and expansion opportunities across all AgriTech accounts.

**Team Leadership & Customer Success Operations**

▪Lead, mentor and develop a team of Account Managers and Customer Success Managers; set goals linked to retention, adoption and expansion metrics, review performance and build a strong bench.

▪Define account segmentation and coverage models (strategic, growth and scaled tiers) and ensure clear ownership of every customer within the team.

▪Establish the customer success operating model for the vertical, including the customer journey, health scoring, renewal cadence, support tiers and escalation paths aligned to platform SLAs.

▪Build scalable playbooks for onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion and churn prevention, along with reusable configuration templates and account review frameworks.

▪Partner with the Implementation and Onboarding team, who own platform configuration, integrations and go-live, to ensure a seamless transition from sale to onboarding to steady-state usage, with clearly agreed roles between customer success and implementation.

**Onboarding, Adoption & Time-to-Value**

▪ Be the customer’s primary point of contact through onboarding onto the platforms: align on the scope of modules and configuration, success criteria, go-live milestones and time-to-value targets.

▪Work with the Implementation team to track onboarding progress, including tenant setup, code generation and packaging hierarchy configuration, loyalty program rules, user provisioning and integrations, against the commitments made to the customer.

▪Identify onboarding risks and dependencies early, including pending customer inputs, master data, approvals or IT readiness, and drive them to closure with the Implementation team.

▪Provide customers with regular, transparent updates on onboarding status, release timelines and next steps.

▪ Drive post go-live adoption by monitoring platform usage and engagement metrics such as active users, enrolments, scan and authentication volumes, claims, redemptions and feature adoption, and run targeted adoption plans where usage is below benchmark.

▪Capture feature requests and configuration change requests, validate them against the product roadmap, separate standard capabilities from custom work, and route them to Product and Implementation with clear priority and commercials.

**Subscription Revenue, Renewals & Expansion**

▪Own recurring revenue outcomes for the AgriTech portfolio, including gross and net revenue retention, renewals and expansion ARR.

▪Lead commercial discussions on subscription plans, pricing tiers, usage-based components, contract renewals and add-on modules, in alignment with leadership.

▪Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities across the platform suite, such as extending traceability customers into loyalty and engagement, adding new SKUs, plants, geographies, user groups or modules, and new use cases like anti-counterfeiting and demand generation.

▪Support new business by participating in platform demos, proposals, solution walkthroughs and reference calls for AgriTech prospects.

▪ Forecast renewals, churn risk and expansion pipeline for the vertical and report to leadership.

**Escalation & Platform Issue Management**

▪Act as the senior escalation point for critical customer issues during onboarding and in production, ensuring rapid triage, root-cause analysis and clear ownership across Support, Engineering and Product.

▪
Identify recurring issues and product gaps across accounts and drive permanent fixes into the product roadmap rather than one-off workarounds.

▪Track platform SLAs, support ticket trends, resolution times and customer-impacting incidents across the portfolio.

**Customer Health, Business Reviews & Reporting**

▪Run quarterly and executive business reviews with customer leadership, presenting platform usage, program performance, ROI delivered and the adoption and expansion roadmap.

▪
Define and track customer health scores using signals such as product usage, feature adoption, engagement trends, support history, NPS/CSAT and renewal risk.

▪Provide leadership with regular reporting on portfolio health, ARR movement, retention, churn risk and team performance.

▪ Use platform and program data to demonstrate business impact and identify where additional modules or capabilities can deliver more value.

**Voice of the Customer & Product Collaboration**

▪Represent the customer perspective internally and consolidate structured product feedback across accounts for the Product and Engineering teams.

▪ Participate in roadmap discussions, beta programs and release planning, and drive customer adoption of new platform features.

▪ Bring market, competitor and industry insight into product and business strategy discussions.

**AgriTech & Industry Engagement**

▪Stay current with developments across digital agriculture, traceability, counterfeiting and product authentication, channel and farmer engagement, sustainability and agricultural supply chains.

▪Help customers understand how traceability, loyalty and data-driven platforms can improve channel, dealer and farmer outcomes.

▪ Represent Elevatoz at customer events and industry forums where appropriate.

**What We’re Looking For**

▪ 8–12 years of experience in SaaS Account Management, Customer Success, Key Account Management or a similar customer-facing role, with at least 3–4 years leading a team and managing a portfolio of enterprise SaaS accounts.

▪ Prior experience in AgriTech, agri-inputs (seed, crop protection, fertilizer), farm mechanization, dairy or agri-focused technology, loyalty or traceability environments, with the ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders in the sector.

▪ Proven track record of driving retention, renewals and expansion in a B2B SaaS or subscription business, with ownership of metrics such as ARR, NRR, GRR and churn.

▪Commercial ownership: experience with recurring revenue targets, subscription pricing, renewal negotiations and account-level profitability.

▪Hands-on experience managing customers on configurable, enterprise SaaS platforms, including onboarding, adoption and integration-heavy deployments, from the customer-facing side.

▪Strong cross-functional follow-through: ability to align Implementation, Support, Product and Engineering teams around customer commitments across multiple accounts in parallel.

▪Comfortable working with product analytics, usage dashboards, health scores and CRM or customer success tools.

▪ Willingness to travel to customer offices and locations for reviews, escalations and relationship meetings as required.

**Platform & Domain Understanding**

We are not looking for a software developer or an implementation specialist, but the candidate should be platform-fluent and curious. You should understand our platforms well enough to demonstrate them, discuss configuration, integrations and roadmap credibly with customers, and challenge internal teams on timelines and priorities.

**Education**

A bachelor’s degree in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Agricultural Engineering, Engineering, Technology, Business or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification in Management, AgriBusiness, AgriTech or related fields is an advantage.

You will work directly with customer leadership, our Implementation, Product, Support, Engineering teams and our business leadership, and play a meaningful role in shaping how we scale customer success and grow our traceability and loyalty platforms in the AgriTech vertical.

If you are passionate about agriculture, excited by SaaS platforms and enjoy leading teams that turn platform adoption into measurable business impact for customers, we would love to hear from you.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About Mitigata**

Mitigata is India's first AI-native, full-stack cyber resilience company. Most businesses buy security, compliance, and insurance as three separate products from three separate vendors. We bring all three onto one platform, so a single partner can assess a client's risk, help prevent a breach, prove compliance, and cover the financial loss if an incident occurs.

Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Bengaluru, we are a team of 175+ serving 800+ customers across 25+ industries and 6+ countries, including India, the USA, the UAE, the UK, and Singapore. Our broking arm, Mitigata Insurance Brokers Pvt. Ltd., is licensed by IRDAI. We are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Nexus Venture Partners, Titan Capital, WEH Ventures, and Point One Capital, along with founder-angels including Anupam Mittal (Shaadi.com) and Nitish Mittersain (Nazara).

**What we do:**

* **Intelligence (Gordon AI):**
  our AI command centre and 24/7 AI Security Operations Center, monitoring and responding across the full stack
* **Security:**
  attack surface monitoring, VAPT, threat intelligence, in-house incident response (DFIR), and a marketplace of 500+ security vendors
* **Compliance:**
  GRC automation and audit support through Gordon GRC, across ISO, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, DPDPA, GDPR, RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, and more
* **Insurance:**
  cyber and other major liability lines, placed faster and priced better because our own security data informs the underwriting

Because these layers share data, each one strengthens the others: security insights inform underwriting, a stronger compliance posture can lower premiums, and the insurance relationship supports incident response.

Join us in building the first line of defence for Digital India, with products built in India for the world.

**Key Account Manager**

**Location:**
Bengaluru |
**Experience:**
5 to 8 years |
**Level:**
Manager or Senior Manager; final title based on experience

**Role Overview:**

You will own and grow a portfolio of Mitigata's existing customers. This is a farming role: your job is to deepen relationships, protect renewals, and expand each account across our security, compliance, and insurance offerings. Most customers start with one layer of our platform. You will help them see where the other layers reduce their risk and cost, and turn that into measurable expansion revenue.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own a portfolio of existing customers end to end, with clear targets for expansion revenue, net revenue retention, and renewals.
* Build an account plan for each key customer that maps their current footprint, open risks, compliance deadlines, insurance renewal dates, and whitespace across Intelligence, Security, Compliance, and Insurance.
* Identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities, for example moving a VAPT customer to continuous attack surface monitoring and the Gordon AI SOC, or bringing a cyber insurance client onto Gordon GRC.
* Use triggers such as audits, regulatory changes, funding rounds, incidents, and policy renewals to open timely, relevant expansion conversations.
* Build multi-threaded relationships with CISOs, CTOs, CFOs, risk and compliance heads, and founders, so no account depends on a single contact.
* Run quarterly business reviews that show customers the value delivered, the risk reduced, and what to prioritise next.
* Own renewals and contract expansions, including pricing, negotiation, and paperwork, with support from solutioning and finance.
* Work with presales, delivery, SOC, GRC, and insurance teams to scope expansions and make sure what we sell is delivered well.
* Track account health, usage, and escalations; flag churn risk early and lead the recovery plan.
* Keep pipeline, forecasts, and account records accurate in the CRM.
* Share customer feedback and expansion patterns with product and marketing.

**Key Skills & Qualifications:**

**Must-Have Requirements**

* 5 to 8 years in B2B account management, enterprise sales, or customer success with a revenue target, including 3+ years in a farming or expansion-focused role.
* A proven record of growing existing accounts, backed by numbers such as expansion revenue, NRR, or cross-sell wins.
* Experience selling cybersecurity, IT services, SaaS, or insurance to mid-market or enterprise customers in India.
* Confidence leading commercial conversations with senior technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong account planning, forecasting, and CRM discipline.
* The ability to explain technical value in clear business terms.

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to two or more of: managed security services (SOC/MDR), VAPT, GRC programmes, and cyber or liability insurance.
* Existing relationships with CISOs or risk leaders in BFSI, fintech, healthcare, or technology.
* Experience growing accounts through channel partners, MSSPs, or insurance brokers.
* IRDAI broker or POSP certification, or security certifications such as CompTIA Security+ or ISO 27001 Foundation.
* Experience in a high-growth startup.

**What We Look For**

Every role needs strong skills in its craft. Beyond that, the people who thrive at Mitigata tend to share a few traits:

* **You care about the problem.**
  Protecting businesses and people motivates you, and the impact of your work matters to you.
* **You think from first principles.**
  You question assumptions and reason through new problems instead of relying only on how things have always been done.
* **You take ownership.**
  You care about the outcome, not just the task, and step in where you are needed.
* **You act with integrity.**
  You are candid about mistakes and handle confidential information with care. Our clients trust us in their most difficult moments.
* **You learn quickly.**
  Threats, regulations, and our products change often. We value how fast you grow as much as where you are today.

**How We Hire**

Our process is structured and built to respect your time. It typically includes a recruiter conversation, a hiring manager conversation, and 3 to 5 interviews, one of which is a practical work sample based on real problems. We aim to reach a decision within 2 to 3 weeks of your first conversation and will keep you informed at every stage.

Every candidate is assessed on the same criteria, whatever their background. We handle your personal information with the same care we apply to our clients' data: we collect only what we need and share it only with the people involved in your application.

**Why Join Mitigata?**

*Protecting the businesses that power India's digital economy.*

* **Work that matters.**
  Cyber incidents hit real organisations, from hospitals disrupted by ransomware to directors facing liability claims to startups whose funding is put at risk after a breach. Your work helps protect their systems, their finances, and their reputation.
* **A distinctive model.**
  We combine cybersecurity, compliance, and liability insurance in one company, because protection works best when prevention and coverage go together.
* **Room to build.**
  We are building an AI-native platform and one of India's most comprehensive AI-driven Security Operations Centers, with real scope to solve problems from first principles.
* **Growth that follows impact.**
  We are early and growing quickly, so scope often expands faster than headcount. People who learn fast and take ownership see their responsibilities grow with them.
* **Startup pace, institutional foundations.**
  IRDAI-licensed, backed by leading investors, and trusted by 800+ customers, while still moving at the speed of a startup.
* Competitive compensation,
  **ESOPs**
  , and the opportunity to contribute to work with national impact.

If you want your work to protect the people and businesses behind India's growth, we would love to hear from you.
**Build for protection. Build for Bharat 🇮🇳**

**To Apply:**
Send your resume to Vignesh.g@mitigata.com with the subject line "Key Account Manager -

Life at Mitigata

Regards

Vignesh G

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**What Do We Do**
ShopDeck helps e-commerce merchants set up and manage their D2C storefront “profitably”.
  
  
**Proposition For Merchants**
D2C selling made as easy as selling on e-com marketplaces
  
  
**Why build this?**

* India’s D2C wave has been limited to venture-funded D2C brands today
* The art of selling on your own website is not democratised. There are ~500k-1M sellers who can sell D2C but can at best sell on marketplaces
* Philosophically - we feel brand owners should spend most of their time on the product and not on channel optimization
* Shopify / Status-quo software solve for work-flow management of storefront but don’t do enough on “helping” merchants sell well! Our proposition We have a software + services proposition for the merchant with the goal of optimising for the merchant's profitability.

Our product is an all-in-one software stack that gives merchants everything they need to sell D2C, i.e. Storefront, Shipping, Marketing integrations, Communication. Our services layer works on top of this software stack to achieve profitability for merchants.
  
  
Here, we combine 4-key roles in classic e-commerce setup, all relevant for any D2C brand as well:
  
  

* Marketing manager (“top of the funnel”)
* Category manager (“products/merchandising”)
* Product manager (“website/app metrics”)
* Ops manager (“shipping metrics”)

Our services layer measures metrics across all these buckets to optimise and take appropriate actions for merchant’s profitability.Over time, the goal is to productize our services layer - which we believe will move the baseline of what merchants expect from a storefront software.
  
  
**Founders**

* Rishabh Verma
* Harmin Shah

**Role Charter**
How will this role shape you? Imagine managing multiple businesses across diverse categories—exciting, right? As a KAM, you’ll be the single point of contact (SPOC) for these sellers, tackling complex daily challenges while enhancing your skills in communication, interpersonal relations, and coordination. **What will an ideal candidate look like?**

* Experience: Freshers to candidates with up to 1 year of experience in an MNC, start-up, or reputed organisation are welcome. Prior e-commerce experience is a plus!
* Education: You hold a degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field; MBA candidates are especially welcome.
* Tech-Savvy: Familiarity with CRM tools (like Salesforce) and dashboards, plus the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly.
* Customer-Centric: You can anticipate customer needs, proactively tackle issues, and drive satisfaction.
* Relationship Builder: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills enable you to forge strong connections with stakeholders.
* Analytical Thinker: You possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, turning data insights into actionable strategies.

* Adaptable: You excel in dynamic, fast-paced settings and are ready for any challenge that comes your way.

title: Strategic Account Manager
description:
**About Us**
A new breed of agency that’s independent, brave, and growth-driven.
  
  
We believe brands and consumers are connected by the internet — a living, breathing bridge of cultural conversations. We operate on this bridge, helping brands stay relevant by sparking meaningful, creative, and measurable interactions.
  
  
Our approach?
**ART x MATH.**
By blending creativity with media intelligence, we deliver ideas that not only inspire but also drive ROI.
  
  
Being an independent agency means we have the freedom to be bold, break convention, and pivot quickly, exactly what it takes to win in today’s ever-changing market.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a social-first
**Strategic Account Manager**
who combines the rigour of a management consultant with deep, practical expertise in digital platforms and the ability to run accounts end to end. This is not a coordination-only client servicing role.
  
  
You will diagnose business and communication problems,challenge briefs constructively, develop social strategies independently, translate them into calendars and lead the team responsible for delivery.
  
  
You will be the strategic and operational owner of a portfolio of up to five social retainers, partnering with a senior creative lead who owns creative craft. You should be equally comfortable discussing a client’s business priorities, analysing audience retention on a reel, presenting a 90-day plan and fixing a delivery bottleneck.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Client and business diagnosis: understand objectives, audiences, category dynamics, competitors, brand constraints and the real problem behind a brief; ask the difficult questions before recommending content.
* Social strategy: independently audit social presence, develop hypotheses, conduct platform/category research, define audience and content strategy, build quarterly roadmaps and recommend channel roles and success measures.
* Platform leadership: bring deep expertise in Instagram first, followed by LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook and
* Reddit; stay current on formats, discovery, audience behaviour, content mechanics and community dynamics.
* Content planning: lead monthly planning, content pillars, platform-specific calendars, briefs, topical opportunities and campaign recommendations; translate strategic choices into work the creative team can execute.
* Performance and experimentation: use advanced platform analytics, audience cohorts, retention, watch time, engagement quality, funnels, attribution limitations, testing and ROI frameworks to recommend improvements.
* Distribution thinking: consider creator collaborations, influencer amplification, community-page seeding, social listening, digital PR and paid amplification when relevant to the business objective.
* Account operations: own scope, milestone plans, calendar lock dates, resourcing requests, approvals,publishing readiness, reporting, client feedback, revisions, escalations and delivery quality.
* Commercial stewardship: understand retainer economics, utilisation, profitability, scope creep and opportunities for expansion; partner with Priyanka on pricing and significant commercial decisions.
* Team leadership: manage, coach and develop Account Executives; delegate tracking without delegating accountability; build a team capable of independent, reliable execution.
* Client advisory: develop trusted relationships, lead routine strategic conversations and constructively challenge weak briefs. Co-lead major reviews, sensitive client conversations and high-stakes presentations with Head of Business and Director of Business Development

**Decision rights and collaboration**

* Own strategic relevance, client understanding and account delivery; the creative counterpart owns creative craft and execution quality.
* Routine BAU work is jointly approved by the Account Manager and Creative Lead under the Social Protocol. Neither party overrides the other unilaterally.
* Where the two disagree, resolve through evidence and discussion; escalate unresolved decisions to BAU Head or the designated senior decision-maker.
* Escalate major client, reputation, commercial or delivery risks at the appropriate time rather than either hiding problems or involving leadership in routine work.
* Work with the broader Pod to maintain day-to-day delivery while ensuring each account has a credible quarterly direction.

**What You Should Bring**

* 4–6 years of relevant experience across digital/social strategy, client leadership, account management or adjacent roles; agency experience is useful but not mandatory.
* Demonstrable social-first expertise and the ability to explain why specific formats, platform choices and distribution approaches work.
* A consulting mindset: structured problem definition, clear hypotheses, research discipline, evidence-led recommendations and persuasive storytelling.
* Experience developing and implementing social plans—not just creating presentations or managing calendars.
* Advanced comfort with analytics and measurement, including the distinction between content performance,distribution performance and business outcomes.
* Strong client communication, relationship-building and constructive challenge; confidence without unnecessary confrontation.
* Commercial awareness and operational discipline across simultaneous accounts, deadlines, creative teams and competing priorities.
* Ability and willingness to train junior colleagues and thrive in the pace, ambiguity and collaboration of agency life.

**How Success Will Be Evaluated**
Performance will be measured against Wirality’s Account Manager KRAs and the Social Protocol, with particular emphasis on:
  
  

* Quality and effectiveness of quarterly strategies and monthly content plans.
* Client satisfaction, retention, relationship quality and strength of recommendations.
* On-time delivery, planning reliability, scope control and account commercial health.
* Measurable platform learning, experimentation and performance improvement.
* Quality of AE development, cross-functional collaboration and reduction in preventable senior escalations.
* Contribution to proactive opportunities and innovation across the account portfolio.

**Growth opportunity**
The intended progression is Cluster Head – Strategy. Promotion is performance-based: the individual should consistently meet the existing Account Manager KRAs with ease and demonstrate performance approximately 20% beyond the expected standard, alongside clear evidence that they can lead others and manage a wider
  
  
strategic remit. This is not a time-bound promotion promise.
  
  
**What This Role Is Not**
This is not a role for someone whose primary strength is following up with designers, passing on client feedback or producing generic calendars. We need a strategic advisor who also takes ownership of execution—and who can help make the Pod less dependent on senior management for routineSkills: digital,communication,strategy

We invest in you.

title: Associate Director - Technical Account Management
description:

Hevo Data is a no-code data pipeline platform that helps companies consolidate data from multiple sources for faster analytics. Our fully managed pipelines let data teams move data from 150+ sources (databases, SaaS applications, cloud storage, SDKs, streaming services) into warehouses and lakes, all without writing code.

Over 2,000 data teams in 45+ countries use Hevo, including DoorDash, Foot Locker, Iceland Air and Shopify. We’re top-rated in the G2 Data Pipeline category, backed by Sequoia Capital, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, and operate out of San Francisco and Bangalore.

**Why This Role Matters**

Hevo’s customers are data engineers, analytics leaders, and platform teams who rely on us for critical data infrastructure. Customer Success here goes well beyond satisfaction surveys. The job is to help technical teams get real value from their pipelines, cut the time it takes to get to insight, and grow their data operations.

We’re looking for a strong leader to build and run the CS function. You’ll own the full post-sales journey (onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion) and be directly accountable for Net Revenue Retention and customer health across our global base.

**The Setup**

* A growing team of TAMs, based primarily in Bangalore and Pune
* A product with 1000+ customers but an evolving post-sales playbook for 250-300 accounts
* A customer base spanning SMB to enterprise across e-commerce, fintech, medtech and B2B Software companies.
* Strong executive support and buy-in for investing in Technical Account Management
* A chance to shape CS strategy at a company that’s defining the data pipeline category

**Responsibilities**

**Build and Own the TAM Program**

* Design and roll out Hevo-specific TAM playbooks covering onboarding, adoption, health scoring, renewal, and expansion
* Segment the customer base (enterprise, mid-market, self-serve) and build the right engagement model for each
* Own net revenue retention, gross retention, and expansion metrics

**Drive Customer Outcomes**

* Improve renewal rates and reduce churn by driving deeper product adoption and making sure customers see tangible results
* Work with Sales on cross-sell and upsell opportunities, always leading with retention
* Build customer advocacy through NPS programs, case studies, and community engagement
* Grow lifetime value by catching risks early through health monitoring and having clear playbooks for when to step in

**Customer Lifecycle**

* Map out the customer journey for Hevo’s technical buyers and end users
* Set up the right checkpoints across the lifecycle (usage data, satisfaction signals, support sentiment) and create standard responses for each stage
* Keep improving based on what the data and customer feedback tell you

**Lead and Grow the Team**

* Hire and develop strong TAMs
* Put together an onboarding process that gets new hires productive fast
* Build a team culture where people are technically curious, care about customers, and take ownership of outcomes

**Measure What Matters**

* Define and track operational metrics: time-to-value, adoption rates, health scores, NRR, GRR.
* Build dashboards and regular review cadences, and report key metrics to the executive team and board

**Cross-Functional Work**

* Work with Product to make sure customer insights feed into the roadmap
* Coordinate with Sales on ideal customer definition, handoff process, and expansion pipeline
* Team up with Marketing on customer campaigns, advocacy programs, and lifecycle comms
* Work with Finance on forecasting, renewal projections, and unit economics

**Invest in CS/TAM Technology**

* Use AI and automation to make the program more efficient and scale the team’s impact without growing headcount at the same rate

**Who We’re Looking For**

**Must-Have**

* 10+ years of overall experience, and 5+ years leading Technical Customer Success or Tech Account Mgmt teams in B2B SaaS, with experience building or scaling a technical CS/TAM function
* Experience with technical or developer-facing products, ideally in data infrastructure, analytics, or related areas like ETL/ELT, data warehousing, observability, or DevOps
* Track record of owning and improving net revenue retention in a subscription / recurring-revenue business
* Comfortable managing technical CSEs who spend their days working with data engineers and analysts
* Analytical and numbers-driven. You make decisions based on data and you build the systems to track it
* Strong communication skills. Comfortable presenting to the board and working across functions to get things done

**Nice-to-Have**

* Time spent at a modern data stack company (Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks, Airbyte, or similar)
* Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models
* Mix of technical (engineering, solutions) and business (CS, account management) experience
* Experience managing CSEs across multiple geographies or time zones

**Why Hevo**

* We’re in a large, growing market (data integration is projected to hit $17B+) and we’re one of the leaders
* Our customers actually like the product. Top-rated on G2, with strong word-of-mouth growth
* Sequoia Capital-backed with strong investor support
* CS is treated as a growth function here, not a cost center. You’ll have real ownership
* Low-ego team with deep engineering and product roots
