title: Head of Premier Technical Support
description:
**About Hevo**

Hevo Data is a no-code data pipeline platform that helps companies consolidate data from multiple sources for faster analytics. Our fully managed pipelines let data teams move data from 150+ sources (databases, SaaS applications, cloud storage, SDKs, streaming services) into warehouses and lakes, all without writing code.

Over 2,000 data teams in 45+ countries use Hevo, including DoorDash, Foot Locker, Arhaus, and Santander. We're top-rated in the G2 Data Pipeline category, backed by Sequoia Capital, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, and operate out of San Francisco and Bangalore.

**Why This Role Matters**

Hevo's customers are data engineers, analytics leaders, and platform teams who run critical data infrastructure on us. When a pipeline breaks, their dashboards, reports, and downstream systems break with it. For our top accounts, every interaction with Hevo should feel white-glove: proactive, personal, and technically credible.

Premier Support at Hevo is not a ticket queue. It is a named, technical account management function that partners closely with our Account Management team to drive adoption, deepen usage, and protect renewals across our most valuable customers. Account Managers own the commercial relationship; you and your team own the technical relationship and the day-to-day customer experience that keeps these accounts healthy and growing.

We're looking for a hands-on leader who is equally at home in a customer business review, a Sev-1 war room, a weekly team operating review, and an API error log. We're a startup: you'll inherit a strong team and a solid foundation, not a finished playbook, and you'll be expected to build what's missing.

**The Setup**

* A growing team of Technical Account Managers/Premier Support Engineers, based primarily in Bangalore and Pune
* 1,000+ customers, with a dedicated premier engagement model for our top 250–300 accounts that you will shape
* A close partnership with Account Management: they own the commercial relationship, your team owns technical success, adoption, and the customer experience
* A customer base spanning SMB to Enterprise across e-commerce, Fintech, Medtech, and B2B Software
* Strong executive support and investment in white-glove, proactive customer engagement
* A chance to define what premier support means at a company leading the data pipeline category

**What This Role Is Built On**

Four things matter most for success in this role, and we hire and evaluate against all four: customer management and communication, team management and operational diligence, technical strength in B2B cloud technologies, and high agency. The responsibilities below are organized around them.

**Responsibilities**

**1. Customer Management and Communication**

* Own the technical relationship with premier accounts end to end: onboarding, adoption, stability, escalations, and renewal readiness
* Deliver a white-glove experience for top customers: named coverage, proactive check-ins, regular business reviews, and a single accountable point of contact when things go wrong
* Partner with Account Managers on joint account plans, QBRs, renewal risk reviews, and expansion opportunities, always leading with adoption and retention
* Drive adoption: make sure customers are getting value from the pipelines, sources, and features they bought, and catch usage drops before they become churn risks
* Personally lead high-severity and executive-level escalations, and run clear, timely incident communication and customer-facing RCAs
* Build customer advocacy through NPS/CSAT programs, references, and case studies

**2. Team Management and Operational Diligence**

* Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of TAMs and Premier Support Engineers, including future team leads
* Design and run the operating model: account segmentation (Enterprise, Mid-market, Growth), coverage ratios, SLAs, severity levels, and escalation framework
* Build playbooks for onboarding, proactive health monitoring, health scoring, escalation management, renewal readiness, and expansion
* Define and track input and output metrics, and use them to run the team week to week:
* Input: First Response Time, Time-to-Resolution, backlog and ticket aging, escalation rate, proactive touchpoints, business review coverage, pipeline health coverage
* Output: CSAT, NPS, Time-to-Value, Adoption, Health Scores, NRR, GRR
* Run a disciplined weekly cadence on at-risk accounts, open escalations, and team capacity, with clear owners and follow-through
* Report key metrics and insights to the executive team

**3. Technical Leadership**

* Be the most credible technical voice for premier customers: get hands-on with pipeline failures, API and integration issues, data latency, schema changes, and source/destination problems alongside your engineers
* Diagnose issues across the B2B cloud stack: REST APIs, authentication (OAuth, API keys), rate limits, webhooks, networking, and cloud data warehouse
* Be the voice of the premier customer to Product and Engineering, turning support and adoption trends into roadmap and reliability priorities
* Raise the team's technical bar through enablement, runbooks, and knowledge sharing, so new hires become productive fast
* Use AI, automation, and self-serve tooling to improve resolution speed and scale the team's impact without growing headcount at the same rate

**4. High Agency and Building**

* Build the premier support function from where it is today: spot gaps, make decisions, and ship improvements without waiting for a finished blueprint
* Roll up your sleeves when needed, whether that means taking a key account, jumping on a ticket, or building the first version of a dashboard yourself
* Make calls with incomplete information, own the outcome, and adjust quickly
* Drive change across Account Management, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Finance through data and influence rather than authority
* Own the outcome metrics for the premier base: Gross Retention, Net Revenue Retention, and Adoption

**Who We're Looking For**

**Must-Have**

* **Experience:**
  12–18 years overall, with 5+ years leading Technical Account Management, Premier / Enterprise Support, Customer Success Engineering, or Support Engineering teams in B2B SaaS

* **Customer management and communication:**
  a track record of owning relationships with enterprise customers, personally handling critical escalations, and turning at-risk accounts into advocates. Clear and crisp in writing and in the room, with both a customer's engineers and their C-level executives

* **Team management and operational diligence:**
  has built and run a team on a clear operating rhythm of KPIs, SLAs, and reviews; understands how input metrics drive outcomes; has hired well and made hard people calls

* **Technical strength:**
  hands-on depth in B2B cloud technologies: SaaS platforms, APIs and integrations, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), ideally with exposure to data systems (databases, warehouses, ETL/ELT). You can read logs, debug a failing API call or pipeline, and hold your own with a customer's engineers

* **High agency:**
  clear evidence of building or rebuilding a function rather than just running an existing one, ideally in a startup or high-growth environment. You act without waiting for permission and own results end to end

* **Commercial awareness:**
  understands how adoption and customer experience drive renewal and expansion, and has partnered with Account Management or Sales on retention outcomes

**Nice-to-Have**

* Time spent at a modern data stack, integration, or cloud infrastructure company (Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks, Airbyte, Confluent, or similar)
* Direct ownership of retention and expansion metrics (NRR, GRR) in a subscription or recurring-revenue business
* Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing, and using usage data to drive adoption
* Mix of technical (engineering, SRE, solutions) and business (support, CS, account management) experience
* Experience managing teams across multiple geographies or time zones, especially supporting US customers from India
* Experience introducing AI or automation into support or customer success operations

**Why Hevo**

* We're in a large, growing market (data integration is projected to hit $17B+) and we're one of the leaders
* Our customers actually like the product: top-rated on G2, with strong word-of-mouth growth
* Sequoia Capital-backed with strong investor support
* Premier support is treated as a growth and retention function here, not a cost center. You'll have real ownership and a seat at the table
* Startup pace and scope: your decisions show up in customer outcomes within weeks, not quarters
* Low-ego team with deep engineering and product roots

title: APAC Strategic Partner Manager, Systems Integrators
description:

These partners — including firms like Tech Mahindra, Persistent, Accenture, Deloitte, IBM, etc — serve as critical multipliers in Meta's partner ecosystem, enabling enterprise clients to activate Meta's products at scale through implementation services, managed solutions, and AI-powered delivery.This role will own the end-to-end strategic relationship with top tier regional and global systems integrators, driving incremental revenue by enabling partners to build practices around Meta's monetization products — including ads, business messaging, commerce, and emerging AI agent capabilities. Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, or strategic account management in digital advertising, marketing technology, or enterprise software

* Demonstrated ability to influence product strategy through partner and market insights
* Experience working cross-functionally with teams in a fast-paced technology environment
* Experience applying analytical methods to size market opportunities (TAM), prioritize partner investments, and measure partner performance

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. title: Key Account Manager (Technical) | Facilities Management | Bangalore
description:
**Company Description**
**Colliers (NASDAQ, TSX: CIGI) is a global diversified professional services and investment management company operating through three industry-leading businesses: Commercial Real Estate, Engineering and Investment Management. With greater than a 30-year track record of consistent growth and strong recurring cash flows, we scale complementary, high-value businesses that provide essential services across the full asset lifecycle. Our unique partnership philosophy empowers exceptional leaders, preserves our entrepreneurial culture, and ensures meaningful insider ownership, driving strong alignment and sustained value creation for our shareholders. With $6 billion in annual revenues, 28,000 professionals, and $110 billion in assets under management, Colliers is committed to accelerating the success of our clients, investors, and people worldwide. Learn more at**
**corporate.colliers.com**
**.**
**Job Description**
We are looking for an experienced Key Account Manager – Technical to oversee technical facility management operations across multiple client sites. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring smooth operations, maintenance, compliance, client satisfaction, and financial performance across all assigned locations.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess strong technical knowledge of building management systems, HVAC, electrical systems, DG sets, UPS, plumbing, fire and life safety systems, and preventive maintenance. The candidate must have proven experience in managing multiple sites, leading technical teams, coordinating with clients, and ensuring adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Multi-Site Technical Operations
* Manage and oversee technical facility management operations across multiple client locations.
* Conduct regular site visits and technical audits to ensure operational efficiency and service quality.
* Monitor the performance of site engineers, facility managers, supervisors, and technical teams.
* Ensure uninterrupted operation of critical equipment and building infrastructure across all sites.
* Review site-level operational reports, maintenance schedules, breakdowns, and pending work orders.
* Implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and ensure consistent service delivery across locations.
* Technical Maintenance and Engineering
* Oversee preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance of HVAC systems, chillers, electrical panels, transformers, DG sets, UPS, pumps, plumbing, and building management systems (BMS).
* Monitor equipment performance and ensure timely resolution of technical breakdowns.
* Review maintenance plans, equipment logs, energy consumption, and asset registers.
* Coordinate with OEMs, contractors, and specialized service providers for major repairs and maintenance.
* Ensure proper maintenance of fire alarm systems, firefighting equipment, emergency lighting, and other life safety systems.
* Identify recurring technical issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Client Relationship and Account Management
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients across assigned sites.
* Conduct regular client review meetings and provide updates on operational performance.
* Understand client requirements and ensure timely resolution of complaints and escalations.
* Maintain strong client relationships and improve customer satisfaction.
* Review SLAs, KPIs, scope of work, and contractual obligations to ensure compliance.
* Identify opportunities for service improvement, account growth, and additional business.
* Team and Vendor Management
* Lead, mentor, and monitor site engineering teams across multiple locations.
* Ensure adequate technical manpower deployment, attendance, training, and productivity.
* Manage vendors, contractors, and service partners to ensure quality and timely delivery.
* Conduct performance reviews and provide technical guidance to site teams.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, safety procedures, and operational standards.
* Compliance, Safety and Risk Management
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory requirements, electrical safety standards, fire and life safety requirements, and client-specific policies.
* Coordinate statutory inspections, equipment certifications, and compliance documentation.
* Conduct regular safety inspections and technical risk assessments.
* Monitor closure of audit observations and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions.
* Develop and review emergency response plans and business continuity procedures.
* Budgeting and Financial Management
* Prepare and monitor annual maintenance budgets and site-level operating expenses.
* Control maintenance costs, manpower expenses, utility consumption, and vendor costs.
* Review quotations, purchase requests, work orders, and vendor invoices.
* Monitor account profitability, cost optimization, and resource utilization.
* Identify energy-saving initiatives and opportunities to improve operational efficiency.
* Reporting and Performance Monitoring
* Prepare and submit monthly operational and technical performance reports.
* Track preventive maintenance compliance, equipment uptime, breakdowns, complaints, and closure timelines.
* Monitor site-wise KPIs, SLA performance, client feedback, and audit scores.
* Conduct periodic operational reviews and implement improvement plans.
* Escalate critical technical risks and operational issues to senior management.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical, Mechanical, or relevant Engineering discipline.

Additional Information
  
  

* 10–15 years of experience in technical facility management or integrated facility management.
* Proven experience handling multiple client sites simultaneously.
* Strong technical knowledge of HVAC, electrical systems, DG sets, UPS, BMS, plumbing, pumps, and fire and life safety systems.
* Experience in managing site engineers, facility managers, vendors, and technical service teams.
* Strong client management, stakeholder coordination, and escalation-handling skills.
* Experience in budgeting, cost control, SLA/KPI monitoring, and operational reporting.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and facility management systems.
* Willingness to travel regularly across assigned sites.
* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
* Technical uptime and equipment reliability across all sites.
* Preventive maintenance completion and breakdown reduction.
* Client satisfaction and complaint closure turnaround time.
* SLA/KPI compliance and audit performance.
* Budget adherence and account profitability.
* Statutory and safety compliance.
* Vendor performance and manpower productivity.
* Timely submission of operational and financial reports.

title: Property Partnerships & Growth Manager
description:
Property Partnerships & Growth Manager

**Tripture | Bengaluru, Karnataka | Full-time**

About Tripture

Tripture is a Bengaluru-based, tech-forward hospitality company helping travellers discover remarkable stays and independent property owners grow their businesses.

We curate owner-run homestays, villas and estate stays across Coorg, Chikmagalur, Sakleshpur, Nandi Hills and other destinations across South India.

**75+ properties. 6+ destinations. 30,000+ guests hosted.**

Tripture has been recognised under the Government of Karnataka's ELEVATE 2025 programme.

We partner with property owners in two ways: as an additional booking channel or as a growth partner, helping them improve visibility, attract guests and grow bookings.

We're building a portfolio of beautiful, reliable stays that travellers can book with confidence. We're looking for someone who can help us find the right properties, build strong owner relationships and turn promising partnerships into successful businesses.

What you'll do

**1. Discover and qualify great properties**

Build relationships with homestay and villa owners, follow up on interested prospects, visit properties and assess whether they meet Tripture's standards for quality, location, guest experience and commercial potential.

**2. Build trust and close partnerships**

Understand each owner's needs, explain Tripture's value honestly and recommend the right partnership model: an additional booking channel or a more involved growth partnership. Take qualified owners through to a signed agreement.

**3. Get properties ready to sell**

Collect accurate information about rooms, capacity, amenities, house rules, check-in procedures and pricing. Coordinate photography, work with the revenue team on pricing, and ensure availability calendars and booking arrangements are reliable.

**4. Turn new partnerships into bookings**

Stay close to newly onboarded owners for their first 90 days. Resolve early issues, communicate guest feedback, coordinate with internal teams and help each property get to its first Tripture booking.

**5. Build lasting owner relationships**

Keep owners informed, understand their challenges and identify opportunities to deepen the partnership as they see results. Recognise which owners could benefit from more comprehensive growth support over time.

**6. Keep the pipeline moving**

Maintain accurate records of every conversation, follow-up, visit and partnership status in our Owner Leads and Owner Inbox tools. Bring back market intelligence on competitor offerings, owner expectations, pricing and new properties.

How we'll measure success

* **Quality supply:**
  The number of suitable properties signed and successfully launched each month.
* **Time to first booking:**
  How quickly newly onboarded properties receive their first Tripture booking.
* **Owner satisfaction:**
  Whether partners are satisfied with the relationship and the value Tripture delivers after 90 days.
* **Guest readiness:**
  Accurate property information, reliable availability and consistency between what we promise and what guests experience.
* **Pipeline discipline:**
  Timely follow-ups, accurate records and clear next steps for every active prospect.

What we're looking for

* 2+ years of experience in B2B field sales, hospitality supply, property onboarding or account management, preferably in homestays, villas, hotels, online travel or real estate.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust with property owners and close partnerships.
* Willingness to travel and visit properties 2–3 days a week. A valid driving licence is an advantage.
* Fluency in Kannada and English. Hindi is a plus.
* Strong ownership and follow-through: you keep commitments, maintain clear records and pursue outcomes without constant supervision.
* A practical eye for property quality, guest expectations and commercial potential.

**Good to have**

* Existing relationships with homestay or villa owners in Karnataka or South India.
* Experience with an online travel company, vacation-rental brand or hotel chain's supply team.
* Familiarity with pricing, occupancy, booking calendars or hospitality revenue management.

What we offer

* Fixed salary plus performance incentives tied to properties going live and receiving their first Tripture booking.
* Travel expenses reimbursed.
* The opportunity to work directly with the founder and shape how Tripture builds its property network.
* A role combining fieldwork, relationship building, commercial decision-making and technology-enabled operations.
* The chance to discover some of South India's most beautiful places as part of your work.

Interested?

If you enjoy meeting people, spotting great properties, building relationships and turning opportunities into results, we'd love to hear from you.

Send us your CV along with a short note about your relevant experience and current CTC to hello@tripture.in

**Location:**
Bengaluru, with travel across South India. Office Location: Church Street, Bangalore.

description:

**The opportunity**

**The role**
As a
**Technology Consultant**
, you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring
**15+ YEARS**
of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.
  
  
**You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are**

* A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
* A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
* Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
* Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

**Role Responsibilities**

* Client Relationship Leadership-Liaison with offshore and onshore Leadership and executives.
* Act as the strategic front face for retail and luxury retail clients, building trusted advisory relationships with Client directors and C-suite, in collaboration with onsite and offshore leadership.
* Lead transformation discovery, executive workshops, value-assessment sessions and future-state visioning across commerce, stores, customer experience, data and operations.

* Identify friction points across the customer journey - discovery, purchase, fulfilment, service, returns and loyalty - and recommend business and technology interventions.
* Technology Strategy, MVP and Innovation Commercialization
* Track emerging retail technologies and translate them into practical propositions, demos, MVPs and proofs of value for clients.
* Shape MVP concepts across AI-driven personalization, GenAI associate assistance, AI stylist, clienteling assistant, demand forecasting, next-best-action, intelligent search, virtual try-on, RFID inventory visibility and frictionless checkout.
* Partner with Sales, Solution Architects, UX, Data/AI, Engineering and Delivery to move ideas from opportunity framing to solution direction, proposal content and pilot execution.
* Create value hypotheses, KPI frameworks and adoption plans to help clients scale successful MVPs into enterprise transformation programs.
* Store Experience, Faster Checkout and Customer Journey Transformation

* Market Presence, Retail Community and Business Development
* Represent the retail practice at community retail shows, luxury retail forums, partner events, industry roundtables and client innovation days.
* Bring market insights back into Valtech propositions, thought leadership, account planning and retail practice development.
* Support RFPs, RFIs, proposals and transformation pursuits with outcome-based narratives, value cases, differentiators and executive messaging.
* Identify whitespace opportunities across existing and new accounts, using MVPs and industry points of view to create demand and bring business.
* Global Collaboration and Stakeholder Alignment
* Work collaboratively with onshore and offshore stakeholders across advisory, architecture, UX, data, engineering, delivery, QA, sales and account leadership.
* Bridge business strategy and delivery readiness by converting executive objectives into capability maps, prioritized roadmaps, MVP backlogs and measurable success outcomes.
* Influence consulting mindset across cross-functional teams, creating alignment between client ambition, commercial priorities, technical feasibility and delivery execution.
* Promote a collaborative mindset, knowledge sharing and consulting discipline across the global retail team.

**Must Have Qualifications**
To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:
  
  

* 15-20 years of experience across retail, luxury retail, digital commerce, business transformation, technology consulting or strategic advisory roles.
* Bachelor degree in business, technology, engineering or a related field; MBA or equivalent strategic business qualification is advantageous.
* Proven track record advising senior retail stakeholders and influencing customer directors and executives with in organization(onshore and offshore) and customer.
* Deep understanding of retail operating models across commerce, stores, merchandising, fulfilment, loyalty, supply chain and customer experience.
* Strong exposure to fashion, luxury, lifestyle, beauty, jewelry and premium retail environments is highly desirable.
* Ability to connect business priorities with technology direction, commercial value, operating-model change and adoption readiness.
* Experience shaping MVPs, proofs of concept, business cases, ROI models, RFP responses and executive-level transformation proposals.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and executive storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and build trust through substance.
* Client advisor: Lead C-level and senior stakeholder conversations across digital, commerce, store operations, marketing, merchandising, technology, supply chain and customer experience.
* Luxury retail experience lens: Shape technology strategy around brand DNA, exclusivity, high-touch service, privacy, premium fulfilment, clienteling and elevated boutique experiences.
* Innovation-to-business ownership: Understand new technologies, identify commercially relevant use cases, build MVPs or proofs of value, and convert them into transformation roadmaps and business pipeline.
* Retail: Strong Participation and drive the client workshops, innovation showcases, community retail shows, industry forums, partner events and executive roundtables.
* Business value leadership: Anchor recommendations in ROI, revenue growth, conversion, average order value, customer lifetime value, loyalty, faster checkout, operational efficiency and cost-to-serve reduction.
* Advisory: Ability to lead strategic conversations, challenge constructively and guide senior stakeholders toward value-led technology decisions.
* Retail business acumen: Strong understanding of retail economics, commercial levers, customer behavior, store productivity and omnichannel operating models.
* Luxury sensitivity: Ability to balance digital acceleration with exclusivity, brand equity, human service, privacy and premium client experience.
* Innovation leadership: Capability to identify meaningful technologies, frame MVPs, validate value and convert innovation into client opportunities.
* Commercial storytelling: Strong ability to create compelling narratives for business cases, proposals, RFPs, transformation roadmaps and executive presentations.
* Collaborative mindset: Comfortable working with onshore and offshore teams across consulting, design, architecture, data, engineering, delivery and sales.

* Thought leadership: Ability to represent the retail practice externally and develop points of view for retail and luxury retail transformation.

**If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.**
**Commitment to reaching all kinds of people**
We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. position based in

title: Seller Systems Team Lead (Night Shift)
description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grows dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs for external users and internal Stripe teams. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
You will manage a team of Seller Systems Operations Associates in a player-coach capacity. You’ll be accountable for your team’s operational performance, development, and engagement, while working closely with global operations specialists, business process owners, and cross-functional partners to improve workflows and user experiences.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the day-to-day operational performance of a team of Associates, including quality, productivity, service-level, and other team goals.
* Set clear expectations, priorities, and performance goals for individuals and the team.
* Manage team capacity, scheduling, and work allocation to ensure critical workflows are covered and work is completed accurately and on time.
* Coach Associates on troubleshooting, process knowledge, communication, and sound judgment in resolving user issues.
* Hold regular development conversations and provide timely, constructive feedback that supports growth and career progression.
* Complete performance reviews and address performance concerns in partnership with your manager and People team partners, as appropriate.
* Build a collaborative, inclusive team environment where Associates can raise risks, share ideas, and learn from one another.
* Serve as an escalation point for complex operational or user issues, using sound judgment to resolve issues or route them to the right partner.
* Partner with global operations specialists and business process owners to run critical Internal Systems workflows.
* Identify recurring issues, process gaps, and manual work.
* Lead or contribute to improvements that increase quality, reduce effort, and improve the user experience.
* Use operational data and team insights to surface trends, risks, and opportunities to relevant stakeholders.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to improve product offerings, processes, tools, and user-facing communications.
* Support hiring, onboarding, training, and ramping of new team members.
* Help build the operating culture, team practices, and capabilities of Stripe Delivery Centers.

Who you are
  
  
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 3+ years of experience leading, supervising, or formally mentoring an operations, support, or user-facing team.
* 9+ years of experience in customer support, technical support, operations, or another internal or external user-facing environment.
* Experience managing operational work against defined quality, productivity, or service-level goals.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to give clear, constructive feedback.
* Experience coaching others and supporting their professional development
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with API integrations, including diagnosing implementation issues, interpreting technical documentation, and guiding teams through ambiguous customer or system problems.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and make practical improvements.
* The ability to prioritize effectively and make sound decisions in a fast-moving, structured environment.
* A process-oriented mindset and a track record of improving workflows, reducing manual effort, or improving user experiences.
* Experience working effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
* A user-first mindset and interest in learning technical products, systems, and processes.
* The ability to work from the Bengaluru office in night shift

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using operational data to manage performance, identify trends, and prioritize improvements.
* Experience supporting hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, or scheduling for an operations team.
* Experience working with global teams across time zones.

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

title: Customer Success Engineer
description:
**About GoKwik**
GoKwik is building the growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, enabling businesses to optimise checkout, reduce RTO, power payments, drive retention, and unlock post-purchase engagement. With 15,000+ merchants globally and a growing presence across India, the UK, Europe, and the US, GoKwik is building technology and financial infrastructure that powers the next generation of digital commerce.
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
As a Customer Success Engineer, you will help GoKwik merchants get the most out of our products by resolving technical issues, supporting product configurations, and ensuring seamless day-to-day operations. You will act as a trusted technical point of contact for enterprise merchants, combining strong troubleshooting skills with a customer-first approach to deliver timely resolutions and a consistently high-quality support experience.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  

* Merchant Technical Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for GoKwik merchants, providing timely and professional support through email and chat.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Investigate, diagnose, and resolve merchant-reported technical issues, escalating complex cases to the relevant internal teams when required.
* Product Configuration & Guidance: Assist merchants with product configurations, customisation requests, integrations, and best practices to improve product adoption and usage.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering, Product, and other internal teams to resolve complex issues and ensure effective outcomes for merchants.
* Ticket & Case Management: Maintain accurate documentation of support tickets, issue descriptions, troubleshooting steps, escalations, and resolutions using Freshdesk and Freshchat.
* SLA & Customer Satisfaction: Meet support SLAs, prioritise cases effectively, and maintain high customer satisfaction through prompt and reliable issue resolution.
* Issue Analysis & Improvement: Identify recurring merchant queries and technical issues, analyse patterns, and recommend improvements to product functionality, support documentation, and workflows.
* Customer Communication: Keep merchants informed throughout the resolution process, explaining technical issues and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support Operations: Work in a roster-based environment, including weekend support and occasional evening coverage during peak periods.

Who You Are
  
  

* Have at least 2 years of experience in technical support, customer engineering, or a similar role, preferably supporting enterprise clients through email and chat.
* Have strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
* Are skilled at troubleshooting technical issues, identifying root causes, and driving resolution independently or with cross-functional teams.
* Have experience using ticketing and customer support platforms such as Freshdesk and Freshchat.
* Understand eCommerce workflows and merchant-facing technology products.
* Have familiarity with Shopify, APIs, product integrations, or SaaS-based solutions; these will be an added advantage.
* Are organised, proactive, and capable of managing multiple support cases in a fast-paced environment.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset.
* Are comfortable working in a roster-based support model, including weekends and occasional evenings when required.

Why GoKwik
  
  
At GoKwik, you will work closely with eCommerce merchants and help solve real-world technical challenges that directly affect their business operations and customer experience. You will gain exposure to a growing commerce technology ecosystem, collaborate with Product and Engineering teams, and contribute to improving both product reliability and merchant satisfaction.

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join Anthropic's India\-based Customer Success team as we pioneer the future of enterprise AI adoption. As a Customer Success Manager at Anthropic, you'll be the strategic partner and trusted advisor to our most complex customers across India helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities \- API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code.
   

  

 You'll develop genuine partnerships with customers, gaining a deep understanding of their business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us. In partnership with the broader account team you, will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives, working closely with them to provide best practices and guidance while supporting them as their usage (consumption \& seat based) grows and evolves.

The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our product development and go\-to\-market strategies — making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business.
   

  

 As a founding CSM in India, you'll be a pioneer \- helping to build regional processes, establishing new customer relationships, and representing Anthropic's brand in a high\-growth market. You'll operate with significant autonomy while maintaining strong alignment with global teams, requiring someone who thrives in ambiguous environments and can work effectively across time zones.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build trusting, strategic relationships with key Indian customer decision makers to understand their business and objectives, identifying opportunities for optimization and expansion
* Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions
* Leverage your deep knowledge of the customer and regional nuances to proactively drive usage planning, understanding current and future consumption/ adoption and how it creates realized value for the customer
* Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities, proactively addressing underutilization across both our consumption\-based and seat\-based products to drive full value from contracted commitments

* Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end\-user adoption and maximize value within customer organizations, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement
* Own the customer experience across their lifecycle — managing comprehensive account and success plans grounded in the customer's business objectives, conducting Quarterly Business Reviews, and serving as the primary conduit between the customer and Anthropic
* Build Anthropic's brand and customer relationships as one of the founding members of the India CS team, developing where needed, India\-specific processes, playbooks, and best practices that account for regional business cultures


**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**
* 12\+ years of experience in customer\-facing roles (Customer Success, Consulting, Success Engineer or similar)
* Experience driving success across both consumption\-based and seat\-based business models, with understanding of different expansion levers and success metrics for each
* Technical fluency with ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns
* Experience explaining and demonstrating technical products to various audiences
* Strategic mindset to identify growth opportunities and translate them into actionable expansion plans
* Cross\-functional collaborator who represents the customer in a positive, proactive manner, rallying everyone around paths forward that solve customer needs
* Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple customer relationships
* Passion for AI and interest in responsible development of advanced systems
* Experience working in and building a growing region, while navigating across time zones with US\-based headquarters
* A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves'' mentality. You are a true team player


**Logistics**
**Minimum education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
   

  

**Required field of study:** 
 A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
   

  

**Minimum years of experience:** 
 Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
   

  

**Location\-based hybrid policy:** 
 Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
   

  

**Visa sponsorship:** 
 We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
   

  

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** 
 Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
   

  

**Your safety matters to us.** 
 To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
   

  

**How We're Different**
 We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
   

  

 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
   

  

**Come work with us!**
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.

 Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

description:
**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for an Assistant Manager, Customer Success to own the parent\-and\-student relationship from onboarding through renewal. This is a retention\-first, commercially\-minded role: you’ll be the trusted point of contact for a portfolio of families, responsible for keeping students engaged, parents confident, and renewals flowing. Success is measured not by activity but by outcomes — attendance, learning progress, refund prevention, and a renewal rate as per industry standards
 



 The ideal person sits at the intersection of customer care and sales. You genuinely enjoy building relationships with parents, you’re comfortable having commercial conversations about renewals and packages, and you treat every family’s lifetime value as your personal responsibility.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Own the renewal (primary mandate)** 



* Take end\-to\-end ownership of the renewal process for your assigned portfolio of families — from early\-stage nurturing to closing the renewal before expiry.
* Consistently achieve good
 **renewal rate** 
 as per industry standards
* Proactively identify at\-risk families ahead of renewal dates and run save / win\-back plays.
* Position packages, add\-ons, and upgrades that match each student’s learning journey.



**Manage parent relationships \& queries** 



* Serve as the primary point of contact for parents, resolving queries around scheduling, tutors, curriculum, billing, and progress promptly and empathetically.
* Build trust through proactive, regular communication rather than reactive support.



**Drive engagement — attendance \& homework** 



* Track student attendance and homework completion across your portfolio; flag drop\-offs early.
* Intervene when engagement dips, coordinating with tutors and operations to get students back on track — because engagement is the leading indicator of renewal.



**Prevent refunds \& reduce churn** 



* Own refund prevention: identify dissatisfaction early, understand the root cause, and resolve it before a parent requests a refund.
* Negotiate and de\-escalate constructively, balancing parent satisfaction with business retention.



**Nurture for long\-term LTV** 



* Build long\-term relationships that extend customer lifetime value — guiding families across levels and years, not just the current package.
* Deliver a consistently delightful experience that turns parents into advocates and referral sources.



**Own the customer lifecycle** 



* Manage the full customer journey — onboarding, activation, ongoing engagement, renewal, and expansion.
* Monitor account\-health signals across the lifecycle and act on them proactively.
* Maintain accurate records of interactions, renewal status, and account health in the CRM.
* Collaborate with Sales, Tutor Operations, Product, and Support to remove barriers and improve the parent experience; surface recurring feedback to the relevant teams.



  





**Requirements** 




**Must\-have** 



* 1\-3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Renewals, or Sales \- ideally in edtech, online tutoring, or a B2C subscription business.
* **Proven track record in sales and renewals** 
 — you’ve personally owned retention / renewal targets and hit them.
* Strong relationship\-building and communication skills, with the ability to build trust with parents.
* Commercial acumen — comfortable with renewal conversations, negotiation, and objection handling.
* Data\-comfortable: able to track attendance / engagement metrics and act on account\-health signals.
* Empathy and patience in handling parent concerns, escalations, and refund situations.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, with strong numerical aptitude and the ability to analyze, interpret, and derive meaningful insights from data.



**Good\-to\-have** 



* Experience managing a high\-volume B2C portfolio (many accounts at once).
* Background in education, tutoring, or working with parents and children.
* Experience with customer success / engagement tooling.



  





**What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)** 



* Consistently maintaining
 **renewal rate** 
 as per
 **industry standards** 
 .
* Measurable reduction in refund requests and churn.
* High parent satisfaction (CSAT / NPS) and improved student attendance and homework\-completion rates.
* Growing lifetime value across your book of families through renewals and appropriate upgrades.

 We are currently seeking a SAP Client Delivery Manager to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN\-KA), India (IN).

 ABOUT THE TEAM
   

  

 SAP Customer Delivery Engagement (CDE) is part of SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS) and delivers fixed\-scope, proactive and outcome\-based services across the entire SAP software stack to SAP’s PaaS and SaaS cloud and on\-premise customers.We manage a variety of customer engagements in HANA Enterprise Cloud, other SAP Cloud Offerings (like SuccessFactors) and on\-premise. The service portfolio includes infrastructure services and Application Managed Services like Managed Data, Testing and Security.
   

  

 We create a stable foundation for our customers’ IT operations and support customers on their digital transformation journey to the intelligent enterprise based on S4/HANA. With continuous access to our expertise and the broader SAP expert network, our customers can take advantage of the latest technologies to support continuous business innovation. SAP CDE helps customers accelerate their innovation adoption, delivering the flexibility to adapt to business changes, rapidly implement technologies and standardize and optimize operations of SAP centric solutions. The mission of the CDE Organization is to maximize the customer success by helping to manage complexity, ensure stable operations, mitigate risk and lowering total cost of operation, support customers on their journey to the intelligent enterprise powered by S4/HANA and releasing investment as well as customer resource capacity for innovation.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

  

 The CDM is the voice of the client within SAP and recognized as the main contact and escalation point for all questions and issues with regards to the ECS engagement
   

  

 The Customer Delivery Manager (CDM) is the personal point of contact for all ECS customers, managing and coordinating all account activities with internal stakeholders and customers. The CDM cooperates closely with the Technical Service Managers (TSM) and the Project Lead (PL) during larger customer projects. The CDM builds a solid customer relationship and acts as a trusted advisor to the customer.
   

  

 The CDM ensures that SAP HANA Enterprise Cloud customers receive the best possible service by focusing on customer satisfaction, contract adherence and profitability. He/She is responsible for ensuring contractually agreed services are being rendered and that change requests are processed in a timely manner.
   

  

 The CDM cooperates closely with the customers’ IT department and business stakeholders, cooperatively planning and coordinating service requests. Also he is in contact with the Management / C\-Level and acts as trusted advisor who grows the business by driving the client’s digital transformation and generating higher customer value. The CDM shares monthly / quarterly reporting on the Service Level with the customer and advises on new services or other developments within SAP HANA Enterprise Cloud that increase the business value for the customer.
   

  

 The CDM role has variations depending on the customer’s contract type.
   

  

 CDM Tasks
   

  

 Some of the CDM’s task include:
   

  

* Actively drives the cloud transformation agenda with key client stakeholders to ensure adoption of S/4HANA and cloud standardization
* Lead the customer engagement and ensures seamless alignment across multiple internal and external stakeholders such as SAP Services, SAP Product support, ECS Partners and customer’s System Integrators or other Hosting Partners

 WORK EXPERIENCE

* Must have Knowledge of SAP’s cloud business, cloud and hybrid infrastructure and cloud operation processes
* Experienced in IT service providers and managing outsourcing engagements.
* SAP Basis, technology, and/or functional knowledge are very important.
* Technical infrastructure know\-how and technical understanding of virtualized system landscapes is critical for this role.

* Experience with SAP HANA and enterprise databases (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2\).
* Knowledge of Linux, Unix, and Windows operating systems supporting SAP environments.

* Experience with SAP ECS, RISE with SAP, and cloud transformation programs.

 in how we dream and innovate

 to feedback, challenges and opportunities

 as a Strategic Partner Manager

title: Strategic Partnerships
description:
**About Astra:** 




 Astra Security is a leader in the penetration testing space, recognized by G2 in the Pentest category. With headquarters in the US \& India, Astra is the trusted security partner for leading brands including Muthoot Finance, Loom, CompTIA, NIIT, Goldcast, HackerRank, Sprinto, ITC \& more. Its one\-of\-a\-kind continuous pentest platform is trusted by 1,200\+ companies across 100\+ countries, from fast\-growing startups to Fortune 100 giants.
 



 Astra's autonomous pentest platform pairs AI agents with certified human pentesters to continuously pentest applications and infrastructure at scale. Vulnerabilities are discovered, validated, and chained the way a real attacker would. Beyond pentesting, Astra's suite includes a DAST Scanner, Cloud Vulnerability Scanner, and API Security Platform, giving teams continuous coverage across web apps, cloud environments, and APIs from a single dashboard. With over 18,000 vulnerabilities detected daily, Astra helps customers prevent millions in potential losses while saving thousands of developer hours. Last year alone, Astra uncovered more than 6\.8 million vulnerabilities for its customers.
 



 Astra's research team actively contributes to the OWASP community, including helping shape the OWASP Autonomous Penetration Testing Standard (APTS) and contributing to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM and Generative AI Security Risks. Astra is CREST\-accredited, CERT\-IN empaneled, and a PCI ASV, reflecting its commitment to the highest standards of security testing.
 



 We've been awarded by the President of France Mr. François Hollande at the La French Tech program and Prime Minister of India Shri Narendra Modi at the Global Conference on Cyber Security. Loom, MamaEarth, Muthoot Finance, Canara Robeco, ScripBox etc. are a few of Astra’s customers
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 At Astra Security, we are building the future of cybersecurity with Autonomous Pentesting — helping teams continuously discover, validate, and fix vulnerabilities across their applications and infrastructure.
 



 We are looking for a Product Partnerships leader to build and scale Astra's ecosystem of technology partners across cybersecurity, SaaS, cloud, developer tools, compliance, and adjacent platforms.
 



 This is a high\-impact, commercially focused role where you will identify the right technology partners, unlock product integrations and marketplace opportunities, and build joint go\-to\-market motions that translate into measurable pipeline and revenue.
 



 You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to take partnerships from identification and negotiation through integration, launch, co\-selling, and revenue generation.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




**Build Astra's Product Partner Ecosystem** 



* Identify and establish partnerships with complementary SaaS, cybersecurity, cloud, developer, compliance, and technology platforms across key geographies.
* Build relationships with Product, Partnerships, Alliances, and GTM leaders within partner organizations.
* Develop a structured partner pipeline based on customer overlap, product fit, integration potential, and commercial opportunity.
* Own the end\-to\-end partnership lifecycle from prospecting and business case development to negotiation, launch, and ongoing growth.
* Build a scalable product partnership strategy across different geographies and partner segments.



**Drive Product Integrations \& Marketplace Partnerships** 



* Identify high\-value integration opportunities that strengthen Astra's product offering and increase customer adoption.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering to define integration requirements, priorities, and launch plans.
* Build partnerships that enable Astra to participate in technology marketplaces and partner platforms.
* Drive marketplace and platform\-sourced business by creating repeatable partner\-led acquisition motions.
* Track adoption, pipeline, and revenue generated through product integrations and technology partnerships.



**Build Joint GTM \& Co\-Sell Motions** 



* Develop joint value propositions, solution positioning, sales plays, and enablement with strategic partners.
* Work with Sales teams to identify and activate joint customer opportunities.
* Build co\-selling and co\-marketing motions that generate measurable partner\-influenced pipeline.
* Coordinate joint launches, webinars, campaigns, events, and other GTM initiatives where relevant.
* Establish processes to track partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced pipeline through the sales funnel.



**Drive Commercial Outcomes** 



* Directly own business outcomes from product partnerships, including partner\-sourced ARR and partner\-influenced pipeline.
* Identify opportunities to expand successful partnerships across additional products, customer segments, and geographies.
* Establish clear business cases and success metrics for each strategic partnership.
* Regularly measure partnership performance and double down on partnerships demonstrating strong customer and commercial impact.



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Act as the internal owner and champion for strategic product partnerships.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure partner initiatives move from concept to execution.
* Bring partner and customer feedback into Astra's product and ecosystem roadmap.
* Create repeatable processes for evaluating, launching, and scaling partnerships.



  





**Key KPIs** 




 Success in this role will be measured through tangible commercial and ecosystem outcomes, including:
 


* Marketplace / Platform\-Sourced ARR
* Co\-Sell / Co\-GTM Pipeline Generated
* Number of Product Partnerships Unlocked in Each Target Geography
* Product integrations launched and activated
* Partner\-sourced / partner\-influenced revenue
* Partner activation and adoption
* Expansion of successful partnerships across products and geographies



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Experience in Product Partnerships, Technology Partnerships, Strategic Partnerships, Ecosystem Partnerships, or Platform Partnerships.
* Strong experience in B2B SaaS, preferably cybersecurity or an adjacent technology category.
* Demonstrated experience building partnerships with technology products and SaaS platforms, rather than primarily reseller or channel relationships.
* Experience taking partnerships from identification → integration → marketplace / platform launch → joint GTM → revenue generation.
* Strong understanding of product integrations, APIs, marketplaces, technology ecosystems, and joint solution development.
* Demonstrated ability to build co\-sell and co\-GTM motions with sales teams.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience tying partnerships to measurable pipeline, ARR, adoption, or revenue outcomes.
* Experience working with US or global SaaS companies is highly preferred.
* Strong executive communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Builder mindset with the ability to operate in a zero\-to\-one environment, create processes from scratch, and independently drive initiatives to completion.

title: Lead- Customer Success (7+Yrs)
description:
**The role** 




 You will own customer experience across TMRW's direct\-to\-consumer brands.
 



 For a set of brands, you will run the function directly — the team, service levels, agent partners, quality, escalations and the daily operating rhythm. Across the wider portfolio, you will own the standard: the playbook, the metric definitions, the tool stack, the quality framework, and a reporting layer that allows any brand to be compared with another on the same basis.
 



 The work is inherently cross\-functional. What brings a customer to us rarely originates inside customer experience alone — it runs through logistics, technology, communications and merchandising. A significant part of the role is diagnosing clearly, quantifying the impact, and partnering with the owning function to resolve it at source.
 



  





**Why this role** 




 Most customer experience roles give you one of two things: a queue to run at a single brand, or a standards remit with no operation underneath it. This one has both. You will run the function day to day for a set of brands — close enough to see what a fix does to the numbers within a week — and own the standard that carries across the rest of the portfolio.
 



  





**How you work** 



* You read customer contact as a signal about the business, not only as a workload to staff for.
* You would rather publish one number everyone trusts than several that flatter.
* You can defend every number you have claimed — how it was derived, what the base was, and what else moved at the same time.
* You judge automation on the experience it delivers, not only on what it deflects.
* You arrive with the diagnosis and the owner, not just the escalation.
* You are comfortable with ambiguity — you build the process rather than wait for it.
* You take ownership past the boundaries of the role when something important is broken.



  





 What you will own
 



**Customer experience operations** 




*For the brands you run directly* 
 — day\-to\-day support across chat, email, voice, WhatsApp and social. Staffing and shift coverage, answer rates, resolution service levels, and escalation handling.
 



**Agent partnerships** 




*For the brands you run directly* 
 — partner selection, commercial terms, service level governance, quality oversight and transitions. Agent capacity is largely outsourced; the outcome is owned here.
 



**Automation and tooling** 




*Across the portfolio* 
 — conversational AI and bot platforms, ticketing, social and calling tools. Platform consolidation and per\-contact economics, working with technology to deliver outcomes through them.
 



**Standards and governance** 




*Across the portfolio* 
 — ticket taxonomy, metric definitions, quality and audit framework, dashboards, SOPs and response libraries, applied consistently across brands.
 



**Voice of the customer** 




*Across the portfolio* 
 — Net Promoter Score programmes, uninstall and exit surveys, app store sentiment, and ticket\-led root cause analysis, routed to the teams that can act on it.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




**Reduce customer contact at source.** 
 Treat contact volume as a signal rather than a workload. Identify the underlying drivers, size them, and work with the owning function to remove them — alongside, not instead of, improving how well contacts are handled.
 



**Work across the portfolio rather than one brand at a time.** 
 Similar drivers recur across brands at different stages of maturity. Diagnose once, address in parallel, and build shared capability so each brand benefits from what the last one learned.
 



**Own the metrics and their definitions.** 
 Publish contact rate per order, customer satisfaction by channel, bot satisfaction, Net Promoter Score, first\-contact resolution, response and resolution service levels, and app ratings. Keep definitions consistent across brands and periods, and be clear about what has genuinely improved and what has not.
 



**Set the automation bar.** 
 Automation carries a growing share of contacts. Hold deflection and customer satisfaction together as a single question, and be deliberate about which queries should always reach a person.
 



**Manage partners commercially.** 
 Negotiate per\-contact and per\-seat economics, govern service levels, and plan vendor transitions with adequate overlap and clear knowledge transfer. Consolidate tooling where fragmentation is not earning its cost.
 



**Build quality as a system.** 
 Attribute dissatisfaction to its source — agent, process, technology or customer — and convert the pattern into coaching, process change or engineering work. Own sampling, audit cadence and training capacity.
 



**Partner with senior stakeholders.** 
 Present regularly to brand leadership and functional heads with a clear diagnosis, a named owner and a specific ask. Own escalations, including the difficult ones, and build the credibility that makes the standard worth adopting.
 



**Lead and grow the team.** 
 Four in\-house leads covering operations, quality and training report to you, alongside the agent teams run by our partners. Set the bar for who joins, run real development plans, and build a bench that can hold the standard without you in the room.
 



 This is a hands\-on role. You will be in the ticket data, in vendor reviews and on escalations yourself, not only directing them.
 



  





**What we are looking for** 



* **Six or more years of experience, with at least four in customer experience or support operations**
* **Direct people management of support teams** 
 — in\-house, outsourced, or both, as their reporting manager
* **Experience in a direct\-to\-consumer or e\-commerce business** 
 — you understand the post\-purchase journey and where it breaks down
* **Consumer contact centre depth at scale** 
 , across chat, email, voice, WhatsApp and social
* **End\-to\-end ownership of vendor or BPO relationships** 
 — selection, commercials, service level governance, quality, and at least one transition you have led
* **Strong data fluency** 
 — comfortable sizing contact drivers yourself and working directly in dashboards and ticket analytics
* **A track record of driving change through teams that do not report to you**
* **Experience building quality systems** 
 — audit frameworks, sampling, coaching loops and dissatisfaction attribution
* **Excellent written and verbal communication** 
 — clear analysis, sharp documents, and a case that holds up in front of a senior audience
* **Confidence with senior stakeholders** 
 — you hold your position with evidence rather than deferring to the most senior view in the room



  





**Good to have** 



* Fashion, apparel or another category where sizing, exchanges and returns are material
* Exposure to India\-specific commerce realities — cash on delivery and return\-to\-origin behaviour, tier\-2 and tier\-3 buyer expectations, quick\-commerce delivery norms
* Experience running customer experience for more than one brand or business unit simultaneously
* Hands\-on experience deploying conversational or agentic AI, with a clear view of its limits as well as its gains
* A demonstrable example of eliminating a contact driver at source, with the impact quantified
* Familiarity with cost\-to\-serve as an operating lever — per\-contact cost, concurrency, tooling consolidation
* Experience establishing customer experience for a new brand or market

title: Partnerships Manager
description:
**Senior Associate (Partnerships Manager) — Global Partnership Management** 




 You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.
 



 Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real\-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world\-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.
 



 That's where you come in.
 



  





**The Role — In Plain English** 




 You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.
 



 This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.
 



 Your week might look like this:
 


* **Monday:** 
 Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates.
* **Tuesday:** 
 Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides.
* **Wednesday:** 
 Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high\-value partner launch.
* **Thursday:** 
 Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week.
* **Friday:** 
 Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy\-in. Start executing.



 You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.
 



  





**What Makes This Different** 




 Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.
 



 You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.

title: Channel Manager
description:
**Senior Associate (Channle Manager) — Global Strategic Partnerships** 




 You don't just "manage" partners. You build the supply engine that powers a global AI platform.
 



 Joveo's recruitment advertising platform runs on machine learning, real\-time bidding, and predictive optimization — delivering millions of job ads to the right candidates at the right moment. But none of that works without world\-class supply partnerships fueling the machine.
 



 That's where you come in.
 



  





**The Role — In Plain English** 




 You'll own relationships that directly impact revenue, reach, and platform performance across global markets.
 



 This isn't account management with a fancier title. You're the person who spots an untapped supply channel in Southeast Asia on Tuesday, negotiates the commercial terms by Thursday, and has it live and delivering candidates the following week.
 



 Your week might look like this:
 


* **Monday:** 
 Analyze partner performance data. One channel is underpacing — you diagnose why and fix it before anyone escalates.
* **Tuesday:** 
 Jump on a call with a new publisher. Pitch the partnership. Negotiate terms that work for both sides.
* **Wednesday:** 
 Sit with Product and Tech to unblock an integration that's been stalling a high\-value partner launch.
* **Thursday:** 
 Build an automation workflow that eliminates 4 hours of manual reporting your team does every week.
* **Friday:** 
 Present your partner growth roadmap to the CXO. Get buy\-in. Start executing.



 You'll talk to partners in the morning, negotiate contracts before lunch, dig into performance dashboards after, and pitch process improvements to leadership by end of day — all in the same role.
 



  





**What Makes This Different** 




 Most partnership roles at this level put you in a box — either "relationship manager" or "operations associate." This one refuses to separate the two.
 



 You'll own the full lifecycle: find the partner, close the deal, launch the integration, track the numbers, optimize the outcome. End to end. No handoffs to five other teams.
 



 Direct access to CXOs and senior leadership. Real commercial ownership from day one. And you're building systems that scale — not just doing the work, but redesigning how the work gets done.
